sngon brjod/༄༅༅/ /stobs ldan rgyal po'i dpal 'byor blos btang nas/ /stobs bri dka' spyad lo drug mdzad 'bras su/ /stobs chen rten 'brel gzigs shing ston pa po/ /stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' shākya seng ger bstod/ / thub bstan kun gsal mdzes ma'i lang tsho la/ /stong dang rten 'byung zung 'jug dbu ma yi/ /rin chen rgyu skar phreng ba'i bkod ba brgya/ / brgyan la mchethog dpa' dpal mabodan klu sgrub rgyal/ /༷ la 'dzin 'phags pa lha dang sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /legs ldan 'byed dang zla grags zhi ba 'tsho/ / grags pa don ldan rnam pa'i gzhung lugs la/ /ji tsam dpyad kyang mtha' dang gting ma mchis/ /chos kun rmi lam glang po'i ngang tshul bzhin/ / rnam rig tsam las phyi don ma grub par/ /'dod pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lam po che/ / phye ba'i sa mkhan 'phags pa thogs med mchod/ /rjes 'brangs dbyig gi gnyen dang blo gros brtan/ /rigs pa'i dbang phyug phyogs glang chos kyi grags/ /'jigs med legs bshad gdong lnga'i sgra che po/ /deng gi dus kyang sa yi khyon kun ldir/ / rgyal bstan drod kyis btang ba'i gangs ljongs yul/ /rig rmongs grang ngad khra bas kun khyab par/ /kun phan bka' bstan nyi ma'i bkod pa brgya/ /ka cog zhang gsum skya rengs stobs kyis drangs/ / 'chad 'gyur rtsom pa'i bgrang yas 'od zer kyis/ /bod ljongs lnga rig pad+mo zhal phye ba'i/ / bka' drin phung po 'dzam gling blo ldan tshor/ / gser ri ji bzhin khur du lci ba yi/ /rin chen bzang po nag tsho lo tsā dang / /blo ldan shes rab pa tshab nyi ma grags/ /dpang wo bu ston mtshon pas khro chen tshor/ / kun gyis bstod bsngags gragarnga/ pa'i 'brug stong ldir/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po tsong kha pa/ / dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen rgyal tshab rje/ / bdud dpung ma lus 'acerdzoms mdzad dge legs dpal/ / yab sras bka' brgyud tshogs zhing byin chen phob/ / zab rgyas dka' pod lnga yi tshig don gnad/ /ji bzhin gab med bstan pa'i thugs rje'i gter/ / dpal ldan bla ma nyi ma ltar grags pa'i/ / lha mi skyubs gcig yongs 'dzin rnam gsum dran/ / snam stong 'gal med dbu ma'i lta ba dang / /'od gsal sgyu lus zung 'jug zab gsang gnad/ /gling 'dir gsal la sngon ped rta ljang can/ / gangs can mgon po gus pas gtsug tu bsten/ /don kun grub pa'i thugs bcud dbu sems don/ /don yod zhags pas bkug 'dra'i dpyad don dag / dag bsher gsar —7///—

sngon brjod/rnying zung 'brel grub 'bras su/ / su la blo gros yod pa des rtogs 'gyur/ / 'gyur dag bka' bstan zhi ba'i rgya mtsho las/ / las skal dka' gnad khyor chu blangs pa 'di/ / 'di phyi don ldan 'dun pa'i blo ldan tshor/ / tshor ba gsar pa skye ba'i bdud rtsir h+pho/ / zhes nang bstan gyi 'byung khungs ston pa shākya thub pa nas nye bar brtsams bdag gi slob dpon la thug pa'i bar gyi lta grub 'di dag gi bstan bdag tshor brgyud pa'i khungs mtshon phyir mchod par brjod pa dang dgos pa bstan pa sogs kyi tshigs bcad 'tshams pa zhig gis sngon bsus te brjod don khrag nag po 'gro shes su bkod sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la 'jug pa gsham gsal/dang po dpyad rtsom 'di dag gi dgos pa/ dbyings gsal bzhin sngon byon mkhas dbang gong ma rnams kyi sku ngal dang rnam dpyod zur 'brel thog ngal rtsol mi mang rnams kyi 'jungs pa bed pa'i gtong phod gnyis 'dzoms kyi rkyen gyi stobs kyis rang re'i pha yul gangs ljongs su lnga rig las brtsams pa'i zab cing rgya che ba'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs dus skabs de'i stobs chen rgyal khab su zhig gis kyang 'gran par mi nus pa zhig bskrun te bzhugs pa de ltar lags kyang / 'on kyang bar bskal dus skabs shig nas nang rig la'ang rim pa gong ma'i bzhed don dang mthun pa'i 'chad rtsom byed dgos pa'i dus rabs kyi rgyab ljongs kyi dbang gis rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi ji 'dod ltar rtsom rgyu'i mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms te 'dzam gling du yongs su grags pa'i nang pa'i lta grub 'phel rim skor rtsod sgrub rig pa dang mthun pa zhig rtsom mkhan byung med/ dgos pa de la brten nas gus rang phyi nang gi shes yon dman rung lhag bsam dngas blangs kyis deng rabs dang mthun pa'i rgya gar gyi nang pa'i lta grub chos 'byung zhig bod kyi nang rig phun sum je tshogs dang gong 'phel dar rgyas yun gnas la sman phyir legs skyes 'bul thub na ci ma rung snyam ste/ phyi lo/ 1976 nas rtsom 'go btsugs nas/ 1988 lorargya gar nang pa'i lta grub chos 'byung deb sngon gsar ma zhes pa'i ming can deb gnyis par skrun byas te 'brel sku da gdan sa khag dang / dpe mdzod khang dang / gzhis byes mkhas pa khrag la blu sku1na tsam du ma zad btang gla yang rang nyid kyis btang nas chos sbyin du 'bul lam zhus/skabs der rang nyid thos rgya chung la nyams myong dman pa'i dbang gis lta grub kyi dka' gnad mang po zhig gi sgor la 'dod pa tshims pa zhig 'bri ma thub pa brten/ de rjes stong cha de dag kha —/5

sngon brjod/skong ched/ lta grub de dang de la mkho ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'tshol bsdu dang / mkhas pa'i bzhed pa phan tshun dpyad sdur rang blo gang lcogs kyis byas te/ phyi khro/ 198'a chos mngon pa'i lta grub 'phel rim deb ther ser po zhes pa'i ming can deb gcig dang / phyi lo/1994 lor ston pa'i mdzad rnam dang gsang sngags lta grub 'phel rim deb ther ljang gu zhes pa'i ming can deb gcig par skrun byas te go mtshungs chos sbyin du 'bul lam zhus/ da lam de dag tu zhib cha 'dems 'god ma thub pa rnams kha skong ched/ mtshan nyid gsum gyi lta grub 'phel rim dang / med pa'i mtshan nyid la 'jug pa'i thabs/ kun gzhi dang nyon yid 'phel rim/ rnam bden brdzun/ bde gshegs snying po'i lta grub 'phel rim/ theg pa'i lta grub 'phel rim/ dbu sems gzhi rtsa'i langs phyogs rang bzhin yod med 'phel rim/ spros pa'i lta grub/ sgrib pa gnyis dang bdag med gnyis/ rten 'brel lta grub 'phel rim bcas las brtsams te mkhas pa'i bzhed pa phan tshun dpyad sdur byas te 'thad phyogs de rang zhib cha bkod par rlom kyi yod/ lar nas dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs dgu bcu 'go tshugs pa dang dus mnyam du dril bsgrags brje len thon bskyed gsar brje'i dus rabs su slebs par brten gnas tshul gson pa gson pa phul phul phan tshun spel res byed rgyu ni thon bskyed kyi gco bor chags yod/ de 'dra brten rang re'i mtshan nyid pa rnams kyis kyang snga srol gzhung chen 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum kho nas rims te deng rabs 'dzam gling du yongs su grags pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i 'chad ce ma lam srol la thugs snang med par bzhugs na mi rabs rjes ma rnams kyi mkhas pa'i gong 'phang gi mdun lam bkag pa dang gnyis su ma mchis/ bdag nyid kyang skyes sbyangs yon tan ldan pa zhig min rung las dbang gis mi yul du mi lo nyi shu brgal bar gzhung chen dka' pod lnga sogs 'chad 'gyur byed dgos byung ba'i nyams myong thog nas bdams bkod byas pa'i dpyad rtsom 'di dag mi rabs rjes ma rnams mkhas pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa la med mi rung 'ba' zhig yin/gnyis pa zhu dag byed tshul/ 'dir bkod pa'i ma dpe dag la brda sprod rig pa'i spyi sgros dang mi mthun pa'i skabs su bcos pa la bcos rtags ma bkod/ dper na sde dge par ma'i bka' bstan du kun brtags zhes gsal ba de kun btags zhes bce sa skyedad/ gang lags zhu —7—

sngon brjod/na brtags zhes pa brtag dpyad byas pa'i don yin la kun btags zhes pa ni gzhan dbang la kun nas btags pa'i bdag ces pa'i don yin cing rtog pas btags tsam zhes pa'i btags pa dang don gcig pas de ltar bcos pa yin/ de yang gnas lnga rig smra ba'i rtsod med kyi mkhas dbang dge bshes shes rab kyis kyang de ltar bzhed de/ dgag lan log smra tshar gcod (rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyi gsung rtsom pod dang po/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du skrun/ 982 9 473 sdi/ 9—12)las/ rjes su yid rangs dang / brton pa dang / kun brtags dang / de bstan pa'i phyir ji ltar yod ce na zhe bya ba smra ba zhes ma dag gral bsgigs su bris pa ni/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / de bzhin sde dge bstan 'gyur du shin du ldang kun du zhes gsal ba de bzhin zhin tu dang kun tu zhes bcos pa yin/ gang lags zhe na de dag la da drag thob cing da drag bsdus pa de la yig tshogs bskyungs shing zor yang ba'i dge mtshan yod kyang da drag la sbyor rgyu'i tshig phrad rnams snga malo'i ltar ma sbyar na da lta yang yul skad dag pa rnams su ji bzhin ngag tu thon pa dag dang mi mthun pas nges par sbyor dgos/ de yang a mdo'i mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung gi thon mi'i zhal lung (kan su'u mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/ 1981 9 89 // 14—18)las/ sde dge zhus chen pa zhesal khrims rin chen gyis sde dge bstan 'gyur rnams su shin tu la shin du dang / kun tu la kun du sogs su bris nas zhus dag btang na yang de tsam gyis rkyag go mi chod de/ to dang cing sogs la rigs 'gre bya ma nus par bzhag yod pas so/ / zhes gsungs pa ni gnad du 'phigs pa'i mkhas pa mgu pa'i gtam yin pas de de bzhin du 'thad/ yang phyi smad dang mi mthun pa'i skabs su phyi mo ( /rtags 'di'i nang du bkod yod/lar nas rang re'i bka' bstan khag gi par ma rnams su ma dag rgyun 'byums su song ba re gnyis 'dug pa de dag rgyal bstan la zhabs 'degs kyi ched rgyu mtshan bkod de zhug dag nges par gtong dgos/ dper na bstan 'gyur khrag gi par ma'i rin chen phreng ba dang / sdur ṇa bod kyi gtsug lag slob grwar zhus chen byas pa'i rin chen phreng ba'i par mas mtshon par ma yod do cog gi le'u lnga pa'i tshigs bcad bcu drug pa'i tshig rkang dang po las/ spungs med so sor ma brtags par/ /zhes gsal mod/ skabs de'i spungs med ces pa'i skabs kyi rgya dpe'i —7/—

sngon brjod/skad dod (bya lnga111 kaums)don la stobs med zhes pa'i don yod pas na/ thog mar kun mkhyen chen po lo chen klu'i rgyal mtshan 'gyur la/ spungs med so sor ma brtags par/ /zhes yod par mngon ces jir man mkhas pa shi ma tha ha dzin ḍan /bya0571 khri'i54ba1(516130751/ba70/0216 5bsku11'am bya 76 gakhu11381551()goXbastusmo1511526khuba'i069576tha'i(10brngubakhukhu1bayotha 1986 ji 224)gsungs pa ltar don la gnas/ de yang zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i (1441—1527)dag yig za ma tog ( 54623 26 50bams lasaḥ75 219201072590ba20611khu'i 10ba 6khu'i khyimaspu'itha'i 19739 9 54)las/ stobs kyi spungs dang me chas sbud/ / ces dang / mkhas dbang btsan lha ngag dbang tshul khrims kyi brda dkrol gser gyi me long ( mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/ 1977399 609—610)las/ spungs stobs kyi mi ste/ brda gsar rnying gi rnam gzhag blo gsal yid 'phrog las/ spungs zhes pa ni stobs kyi ming / zhes gsungs pa ltar zhes pa nas 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum gyi mi brda'i rnam bshad las/ sbungs ni stobs dang brtson pa'i ming ngo / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'thad/ zhon kyang stabs ma legs pa zhig ni yi rge ba zhig gis dag pa sun 'byin te ma dag pa bskyar gso byas pa'i ldi li par ma'i dbyungs can dga' blo'i 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum chen mo las byung ba'i ming brda go dka' ba rnams bshad pa blo ldan dga' skyed (5khyi'i531 11khu 601100 07gag0125 0(me 55870085— 76210sto0/ 2 ba'i655626 khyimatsho'i6515 khungasam sa07 70/khyi1 1971 9 160)las/ spungs ni stobs dang brtson pa'i brda rnying ngo / / zhes gsal ba ni rang gis brtag pas mtha' ma chod pa'i thob rtags mngon gsal can te/ spungs zhes pa brda rnying min pa kun la rlung ltar grags/ de ltar skabs 'brel zhus dag byed tshul dpe tsam brjod pa yin kyang thams cad 'dir brjod pa skabs su ma babs pas go skabs byung na zur spi 'chad par 'dod/gsum pa gzhis byes mkhas par re 'dun/de yang rang re bod mi rnams las dbang gis gzhis byes gnyis su gyes nas yun ring phyin par ma zad da dung ga dus mnyam 'dzoms thub min tshod dpag dka' ba de ltar lags mod/'on kyang rang cag gi mkhas dbang gong ma rim byon gyi mdzad byus kyis yig thog bris pa rnams —71/—

sngon brjod/bod 'chol khra gsum ga la gcig gyur yin pa'i lam srol bzang po yun gnas srung skyob gnang rgyu gal che/ dbartes pa rgyu ma'apron de te1 nar dmigs nas bsam 'char zhu rgyu gsham gsal/dang po/ rjes 'jug ga da na ba ma sa da drag bcas kyi rjes su bdag 'dra dang ming mtha' gang yin yang pa thob pas de la rtsod pa med/ 'on kyang rjes 'jug nga 'a ra la mtha' med kyi rjes su nges gtan med par brten sngon byon mkhas pa chen po rnams kyis bka' bstan du grags pa'i dbus gtsang gi ming chig rnam dag gang thon srog tu bzung ba'i thog nas rtags 'jug gi dgongs don gzhir bzhag gis rtags mtshungs 'dren pa dang / skabs 'gar rtags mtshungs 'dren pa ltar byas tshe yul skad re dang mthun yang bod kyi spyi skad dang mi mthun pa'i skabs su brjod bde 'dren pa'i spyir btang dang dmigs bsal gyi zhib cha phye ba thabs lam bla na ped pa zhig lam ston mdzad yod/ de ltar zhib cha thon pa la brda sgod gtsug lag rig par byung ba smos med thog dbus gtsang rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi skad la byung ba 'ig los dgos/ tshul de las logs su zhabs bro mnyam rgyag dang / sked gzer logs dgar dpe ltar brtag dpyad med par rtags mtshungs 'dren pa'i rgyug pa leb 'dur byas tshe dka' rgyu ci yod/ de ltar lags mod deng skabs a mdo'i mkhas dbang 'ga' shas kyis rtags mtshungs 'dren pa'i rig pa gsar pa zhig rnyed khul gyis mtshon sngon par ma dang / gan su'u par ma rnams su sngon gyi mkhas pa'i spyi srol dang mi mthun pa'i bdag sgra dang ming mtha'i pa ba'i skabs su a mdo'i khra skad ji sted cig bsam bzhin du bris 'dug de dag 'dor len med par ma dag rgyun 'byams su phyin tshe a mdo'i yul skad ltar nam zhig gi tshe yig thog bris pa yang bod mi spyi byings dang phan tshun go brda mi 'phrod pa'i mtshams su mi slebs pa'i nges pa mi 'dug lung pa re la skad re'i dpe don ltar byas te kha skad gang byung yig thog bris tshe bod kyi skad yig gcig gyur la rgyar gnod tshabs che ba'i skor dran dbang dge chos rin po ches deb dkar du nan por gdams pa ni thugs shin tu mad/de yang si tu paṇa chen gyi mu stag phreng mdzes (shes rig par khang nas par 'debs zhus pa'o/1970 ji 297 /1 /0—11)las/ rkang pa dang / khang pa/ stong pa sogs nga yig gis pho drangs pa 'ga' zhig snang ba/ zhes pa'i dper brjod de 'gog phyir/ mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs —71//

sngon brjod /drung gi the na mi'i zhal lung (kan su'u mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/ 980 ba 269 // 1 2 4)las/ 65 lag sha'i kha rgyan (a lag sha bstan dar lha rams pa'i gsung 'bum/ ma'i256/—24/ ste thang ba grags pa seng ge'i /dag yig /gaṅgā'i chu rgyun /sogs )las/ na yig dang ma yig gi mthar /mtha' rten gyis 1mo yig drangs pa'i dper brjod du yin ba/ bcom ba/ zhes /ba phyed lnga ru 'bod pa)bkod /gnang ba /pa rtags 'jug gi tshig zin dang mthun mod deng sang sus kyang las mi len pas dpyad par bya/ zhes pa ltar na mi tus 'di dag la khungs bcol ba 'dra ste mi 'thad pa kho na'o/ / yang rkang pa/ lang pa/ stong pa sogs mo yig gis pho drangs pa 'di dag kyang yul khams 'ga' zhig gi khra skad dang mthun pa'i brjod bde'i dbang yin na ma gtogs dmigs bsal don med snyam mo/ zhes bkag pa gang zhig la te/nga rang gi dper brjod cig tu (9 2679 11 15—16)rjes 'jig mo yig gis pho yig drangs pa bum pa/rtsam pa lta bu dang / zhes bkod pa ni nang 'gal mngon gsal can zhig yin/ phyogs mtshungs a mdo'i mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan gyi brda sgrod blo gsal dga' ston las kyang / (kan su'u mi dmangs dpe skrun bang gis bskrun/ 1980 9 95 // 7—18) stong pa/rkang pa sogs/ la pa bzed thob pa dmigs bsal yin zer ba dang / bzang ba/ dkar ba lta bu la ba bum thob pa dang / bzang po/ dkar po zhes na ro thob tshe pa bzed 'thob zer yang / dmigs bsal gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / na ro can la pa bzed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad rgyu ped la/ na ro can la ba zum med na/ slar bsdu'i so ngo do no bo mo 'o ro loso rnams kyi nang gi bo'ang mi dgos so/ / yang dang po/ lnga pa/ bcu pa zhes nga dang mtha' med la po thob pa mang bo dpe khungs dag pa rnams su yod do zhe na/ gong du smos pa ltar mkhas pa chod ldan rnams kyang 'dod tshul mi mthun pa de 'dra byung bas/ mkhas pa tshad ldan so mdzos bris pa'i gzhung khungs ma rnams la'ang mi mthun pa skudad pa 11sa ci dbo sa/ zhes gsal ba'ang tshe brtan zhabs drung dang mthun par ma zad gsham gsal bstan dar lha rams pa'i bzhed pa bkag pa ni smos ci dgos/de yang a lag sha'i khu rgyan khusko lag sha bstan dar lha rams pa'i gsung 'bum/ 5425041las/ bzang ba dkar ba rgyal ba lta bu nga ra la gsum gyi rjes su ba phyed wa ru 'bod pa thob —smo/ga

sngon brjod/kyang / bzang po dkar po rgyal po zhes na ro sbyar tshe po yig thob pa mkhas pa spyi'i lugs yin/ rkang pa stong pa sogs dmigs bsal dang / yul pa zhes pa bdag po'i tshig gi stobs kyis pa yin thob pa yin/ zhes gsal ba ni dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du gzhung lugs rab 'byums la slob gnyer mthar phyin pa gnang ba'i stobs kyis yul dbus kyi ming tshig la'ang byang ba'i spobs pa gzengs su mtho ba'i 'bras rtags yin pas de de bzhin du 'thad/ mkhas dbang gong ma gnyis ni brda sprod la byang ba'i yongs su grags pa'i mkhas dbang rtsod med los yin kyang dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du slob gnyer gnang ma myong ba'i dbang gis yul dbus kyi skad la ma byang ba'i rkyen gyis yul skad mngon gsal dod po de 'dra shor bar mngon/ dper na mkhas pa de gnyis kyis/ lha sa smon lam chen mor/ rkang ba chos can/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i stong ba yin te/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtags gsal 'phangs tshe/dbus gtsang mkhas pa smos bed thog a mdo'i yul du 'khrungs pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang (1648—1722)gnyis/ (1728—1791) thu'u bkun chos kyi nyi ma/ (1737—1802) gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyungs/ (1762—1823)dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho (1884—1968)sogs kyang yul dbus kyi ming tshig la byang ba'i dbang gis bzhad gad shor ba the tshom ped/don brdo na bod kyi brda khrod gtsug lag rig pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed dpal lang lo tsā bas phyi lo/ )538 lor mdzad pa'i bod kyi sprod kyi mdo dag yig ngag sgron (bod sbyongs mi dmangs dpe skrun lang nas bskrun/ 1980 9 17 / 21 9 35 / 31 las/ rkang pa/ zhes dang / khang pa'i tshoms zhes rjes 'jug nga'i rjes la pa yod pa shin tu mang / gzhan yang ngag sgron (9 45 // 13—14)las/ lung pa mda' pa'i 'byor pa yis/ / yul pa phu pa chim sogs dpyad/ /zhes gsal ba yang dag byed de rnams dpe dag pa kun la cung zad 'khor ram snyam pa'i dga' spobs byung /'a 'bri klog slob spyong / rang lo drug pa brtsams nas klog gi slob dpon rin po che a khu ye shes kyis 'byor klog sogs bslabs/ de rjes yo mang thal rjes dgon pa phug pa a khu phur bu rdo rje dpal bzang po nas klog mthar 'don gnang / rgan lags ni shel dkar mnga' zhabs khongs klog bzang ba'i chod du 'dzin/ khong sku rkyang gis bka' 'gyur cha tshang bcu phrag brgal ba dang bstan 'gyur cha tshang klog myong yod cing nyi re bka' 'gyur pod gcig dang phyed ka tsam las sla bor thon/ rgan lags khang dkar khyim tshang du bka' 'gyur dag 'don ched gdan 'dren zhus shing skabs der kho bo la yang klog bslabs/ gang ltar kho bo'i klog gi khyad chos ni rjes 'jug da na la sa bcas yod pa'i gi gu sogs bed na a drag ( 'i )dang zhabs kyu can la u drag ( khu )na ro can la o drag ( 0 )yong gi yod pas dbyangs sgra brgya da yod/de bzhin dbu med 'bri rtsal rtse son rgan kun bzang dpal bzang po dang / rgan nges ston dpal bzang po/ shel dkar rtsong dpon rgan rdo rje rgyal po/ shel dkar chos drung rgan tshe ring dbang 'dus sogs bsten nas/ sug ring / tshugs ring / tshugs thung / tshugs ma khyug khyug 'bru tsha sogs lo mang sbyangs/ dper na dbu med sug ring gcig po yang byung shing thog lo gcig tsam sbyangs myong / 'on kyang chung dus rtsed mo kho na la dga' ba las yon tan la don gnyer ma byas pa'i rkyen gyis 'bri klog sogs rang gi slob dpon gyi bzhi cha tsam las mi shes/3 stan sum/ de yang snga 'gyur rnying ma pa'i mkhas pa'i dkyil nas rig gnas mkhas pa'i —75/sa

/ ces dang / mi pham pas/ yang dag mkhas pa'i slob dpon la/ / bsten par ma byas rig pa de/ /'phyon ma yi ni bu bzhin du/ / khungs btsun par ni mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing nang don rig pa'i skabs su ni lhag par yang gal che ba yongs 'dzin 'brong dkar rtsebs/ nga yi bla ma'i brgyud pa de/ / mu stag bstar la brgyus pa bzhin/ / nga rang bla ma'i brgyud 'dzin yin/ /brgyud pa med pa'i bla ma de/ /byin rlabs che yang nga mi 'dod/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin du da re skabs su babs pa stan ngag me long le'u gsum gyi khrid rgyun chu mgo gangs gtugs ni/ mkhas grub ngag dbang rdo rje/ spel khang gnyi ta mnga' bdag slob dpon rin po che blo bzang bzod pa/ de nas bdag phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis zhus/ bdag gi mdun nas tshul khrims skal bzang lags kyis le'u gsum gsan bzhes grub cing / lhag par le'u sngon brjod/bshes dge 'dun dpal bzang po dang / dge bshes 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang po bcas dpon slob rnam gsum slob dpon du bsten nas smra ba'i khyu mchog cha ba chos seng gis srol phye ba'i chod ma kyang bla ma dpon slob dang mjal ba'i rten 'brel gyi mthu kho na las gzhung chen la slob gnyer byed rgyu'i bsam pa skyes pa sogs kyi bka' drin dang dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim skabs kyi sku ngal dran rim bzhin da lta rang mjal rgyu byung na snyam pa dang mthun rkyen cung zad re 'bul rgyu'i go skabs byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pa bcos min skye yang kye ma kye hud der zad/gnyis pa 'jam mgon nyi ma rgyal mtshan(1918—1987)dang mjal tshul/ phyi wo/ bu' lo mjug tu gnas mchog lnga rā ṇa sī na dge bshes zhal gyi dkyil 'khor blta bas chog mi shes pa spun 'dzum 'dzum gnang mkhan gang sngon brjod/gzhan gdul bya la'ang de rang dpe 'khrid mdzad pa las bka' chos kyang gzhung chen slob gnyer gyi /ra chad du dgongs nas thob thob mang pe'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes mi 'dug zhal snga nas kyis bka' 'gyur lung dang dang rje yab sras gsung 'bum lung zhus na thob yod kyang zhu ma myong zhes dang / dgongs pa rab gsal dang / 'grel pa don gsal dang / mdo rtsa sogs kyi bshad 'khrid kyang rgya ma zad thugs dad kyang ha cang chen po mdzad/ dus skabs der kho bo rang dbul bas zang zing gi mchod pa 'bul ma thub kyang phyi lo/ 76 nas bzung bka' drin gyi cha shas tsam gsab phyir spyan chab dang phyag sne tog tsam re wo ltar 'bul lam zhus/ 1985 phyi zla/ 'tshos/ 'thu tsam la rgyud smad kyi grwa khang rgyag mkhan gyi sbyin bdag rnams gdan zhu byed rgyu yin pas rje nyid rgyud smad kyi dge bshes myong zhes gsung 'phrin phebs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang chos la dpe mkhyud mdzad pa min par snod min la khrom dbajo bskur na byin rlabs kyi ngad yal bar 'gyur ba dang / slob dpon la'ang sngags kyi rtsa ltung bdun pa 'byung bar dgongs pa yin 'dug cing / lar nas deng sang gi bod kyi bstan 'dzin chen po 'ga' shas kyis dbang yon zhig byung na gsang 'dus dbang chen yang skyabs 'gro tsam yang med pa'i phyi rgyal mi la gnang ba la'ang 'tsher snang med pa'i mdzad spyod dang stabs bstun na kho bos kyang dbang skur byed mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang mi 'dug mod gsang zhing sbas nas sgrub dgos pa'i chos 'tshong thog ltar bcongs na dam tshig dang 'gal du drogs nas btang stoms su —755

sngon brjod/bzhag de yang slob dpon grong byang nas mtshams sbyor gnang ba bzhin gsang sngags kyi gdan sa chen po rda i rgo rji'i ban chen po rdo rje slob dpon kha rbe se la grub thob brgyad cu rtsabazhi'i lo rgyus wo mang 'gyur rogs zhabs ci zhus/ nyin gcig khong gis khyed kyi rogs pa la brten nas nga'i 'gyur la nyi hong gsang sngags kyi rig pa'i mkhas pa'i tshogs 'du'i bya dga' thob cing /da khyed la drin gze'i phyir nga'i yon bdag dad ldan khag la dbang yon nyi hong yan khri gsum ca'i/ re bsdus nas khyed la 'bul rgyu yin na gsang 'dus dbang zhig gnang tse(gas gsungs lan du/ ban chen po khyed kyis bdag la de ltar dgongs pa bzhes par bka' drin che zhu rgyur ma zad/ dgung na shin tu mtho ru bstan par dgongs bzhes kyis thugs rus gnang nas grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i lo rgyus bsgyur par rjes su yi rang dang / bdag la khyed kyis yon 'dod pa tshim pa gnang byung bas 'di lhag re ba'ang med cing / 'on kyang dbang yon ched khrom dbang skur na bdag bi shes rgyud dkor kyis tshos rgyu tsam las dgos pa chung la dgag byu che bas dgongs pa gnang rogs zhus te dbang skur ma byas/ bla ma gong ma'i bka' srol ltar na paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan (1570—1662)yan chad du dge lugs pa'i bstan 'dzin su zhig gis kyang khrom dbang bskur med par ma zad rje rin po che ni stod ldan la'ang dbang bskur ba la mi dgyes pa'ang 'brug rgyal dbang chos rje blo bzang 'phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha po'i rnam thar chen mo (mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang bis par du bskrun/ 1981 k+ṣa 280 117—18)las/ da phyin chad sngags kyi chos than thun 'chad par 'dod pas khyed drag pa 'ga' res chos rje lo tsā ba la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i dbang zhus la sngags kyi sdom pa gsor chug gsungs/ de nas slob dpon rin po tshe 'dul 'dzin pa'i zhal snga nas kyis gtso mdzad pa'i dpon slob nyi shu rtsa lngas chos rje lo tsā ba la gsang 'dus kyi dbang chen zhus/zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ 'on kyang rin po che lta bu'i gdul bya mkhas grub rin po che la ni ma zhus pa'ang dbang gnang yod pa'ang de nyid ( /98/ 9293 // 19—21)las/ ngas da lta rang 'jigs byed kyi dbang bka' byed gsungs nas dgyes bzhin du bka' dbang gnang zhes gsal/ rgyud smad du rje nyid ma phebs pa brten rgyud smad kyi byed sgo rnams grub nas phyi zla gsum pa'i nang rje bla ma mjal bar 'bras spungs su bcar te rgan rin po che gling bla brang du bzhugs —755/—

smyon brjod/'dug pa dang mjal/ phyag btsal te phyag sne gang 'tshams shig phyag rten du phul nas byin rlabs zhu skabs dbu thug mdzad de spyan chab bsil bzhin thugs shin tu dgyes te nga ma phod nas thug tu yong ba red ces gsungs/ 'bras spungs du sdod ring nyin ltar mjal kha la bcar te sngar rje bla ma nyid nas dpe 'khrid mdzad skabs su bka' bstsal pa'i dka' gnad 'ga' shas stan sgron zhu skabs khyod rang la ngas bslabs pa rnams khyon nas brjed mi 'dug nga la rgan rin po ches bslabs pa rnams brjed tshar gsha' zhes dang / bye brag bshad pa chen mo khyod rang la ngas bod skad du bsgyur dgos bshad pa ltar lag len du khel ba byed dgos dang / mang nyung ji tsam 'dug bka' brtsad phebs par bod skad du tshang ma bsgyur na pod lnga drug nges par yong sa red zhus par/ de sngon rgan stong dpon rin po ches bsgyur nas 7gong sa mchog la phul ba der pod gcig las mi 'dug pas cha tshang bsgyur pa zhig yin sa ma red gsungs/ rgan rin po che 'bras spungs bzhugs gdan 'jags rgyu'i dgongs bzhed 'dug sngon brjod/gzur gnas mkhas pa'i mnyes po gnang yul zhig chags song / de 'dra brten dus phyis su blo gsal gling gablo gsar zhig gis khyed kyis chung dus nyin rer khab gcig btsugs pa'i dpe cha blo lan du kho bo chung dus zin rig de tsam yod mkhan zhig min yang nying rus chen po yod rkyen gyis gzhung don cung zad nges po yod ces zhu myong / khrom rwa sogs la ha lam ma phyin par brten rgya gar du dran rim bzhin zhim snang 'char/5 rgyal ba yab sras dang gsang sngags bstan pa dang mjal 〈(la/dang po 7skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal tshul/ de yang phyi lo/bu' khror rda sar tshes/ 15 bod zla/ dze tshes/ 4 gang yin gsal por mi dran yang de gnyis gang rung zhig la/ skyabs mgon mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas kyis mkhan slob sbugs ma dang / rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi mkhan rin po che 'dul ba 'dzin pa bsam gtan chos 'phel zhal snga nas gyis gsang ston dang / brag g.yab skyabs mgon blo ldan shes rab kyis dus go skyabs rje mtshan zhabs gser kong rin po che sogs kyis dbus khra skong 'os pa'i dge 'dun bcu tshogs kyi dbus su bsten par rtsogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa dang / da nas ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du skyid rung sdug rung re sa ston pa shākya thub pa slob dpon du bsten nas ltung ba sde lnga so so'i bsrung mtshams ngos 0561—

sngon brjod/chen mo gnang rgyu'i thugs bzhed yod tshul gsungs/ bod zla/ 4 tshes/ 13 nyin snga dro chu tshod brgyad pa'i thog skyabs rje khri byang rin po che'i drung nas byang sems sdom pa bzhes rgyu med pa de yang ma bzhes te da res sems bskyed rdzas rnams rang rang gi dran rten du khyer dgos bka' bstsal/ byung sdom 'bog pa'i phyag len ni yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar (99236—237)du gsal ba ji bzhin bskyangs/ de myon lam rim bde lam dang / lam rim 'bring po spyod pa spyi bslab yan dang / spyod 'jug che mo bcas blo 'dzin thog nas de gsum sgrags nas shar sgom byed kyi yod kyang / de nas bzung rgan lha skyabs kyis zhal ta mdzad pa bzhin lam rim chen mo'i sa bcad blo 'dzin dang sbrags lam rim chen mo'i sa bcad kyi steng nas shar sgom byas/ 'on kyang nyi hong du 'byor rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang bcu bzhi pa'i zhal snga nas kyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du chos mchog bskyed rim sgom pa'i snod rung byed pa byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang /rtsogs rim gyi snod rung du byed pa gong ma gong chen rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen bo'i dbang bcas dus 'khor dbang chen stsal ba'i dbang gral du tshud/ phyi zla lnga pa'i nang bdag nyi hong la thon khar thon mjal ched chos don las khungs nas go sgrig gnang ba bzhin gzim chung mjal kha zhus/ 'di ni sku dngos kyis bdag la gsung byon pa'i thog ma yin kyang sku bsod dang gzi brjid kyi dbang gis mar bka' gang gnang ba dang yar gang zhus ni mi dran/ 1976 zla ba/ 'a tshes/ 'a7 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen por 'byor mjal dang 'brel nyi hong yul gyi rang gi byed sgo rnams stan seng zhus/ 3 ches/ 8 nyin thon mjal la bcar ste chu tshod 456///

sngon brjod/dang po nas bzhi pa bar 7gong sa mchog dang gang spyir bka' mchid lhug par grol/ gang zag rlabs po che 'di la grwa ba grwa rkyang ltar che nyams med pa dang / bka' mol zhu bde'i yul yin pa'ang shes/ skabs de'i bdag gi spyo spyod la dgyes te yang bskyar0bcar dgos zhes bsam yul nas med pa'i skal bzang spyi bor phebs nas/ tshes/ nya4 nyin mjal kha zhus te rten skal du ston pa'i sku thang zhig gsol ras gnang / 1978 7ba/ 'a tshes/ 16 nas tshes/ 'a5 bar rdo rje gdan du spyod 'jug bka' 'khrid gnang ba'i chos gral du tshud/199 do phyi zla/ 4 tshes/ 5 nyin/ nyi hong du thams cad mkhyen pa sku ngo mas glo bur du tshul khrims skal bzang gzim chung du mjal kha la bcar shog ang zhes pa'i u dum bā ra'i me tog las dkon pa'i bka' lung bdud brtsi dbugs dbyung rjen pa skyi stsal byung bar dga' 'jigs zung 'brel gyis lus kyi ba spu gzings por g.yos/ shod mi dgos par 7gong sa chen po ni deng 'dir 'dzam gling gi dbu 'khrid che shos shig tu 'dzam gling mi mang phal mo ches mnga' gsol zhus pa de ltar lags mod/ zhon kyang gang zag rlabs po che gang nyid la ni de 'dra'i dgongs pa zur tsam yang med par mjal kha gnang skabs su sku dang gsung gi rnam par rig byed kyi 'phrin las 'jug pa rnams kha mnyam lag mnyam grwa ba grwa rkyang gi dge rgan phrug mjal dus dang gnyis su ma mchis par thugs nang gtsang ma'i thog nas gzhung lugs chen mo'i dka' gnad kyi bka' rtsad dang chos srid las brtsams pa'i lam ston bka' slob/ gzhan yang bong ba gser gzigs kyis khyod rang gi ngag rtsom sngags kyi chos 'byung gzigs tshul dang / khyod rang longs sku'i skor bsam tshul ji ltar yod ces bka' rtsad phebs par bdag tsho rmongs pa'i 'char tshod ni 'di ltar lags zhes bka' lan phul bar/ 'o na nga gnyis bsam tshul gcig pa red ces dang / da bar gyi khyod rang gi bgyis pa ha cang yag po byung tshul sogs las brtsam/sa pa'i bka' lung byin brgya'i stong thun spyi bor bstsal/ de mur bdag gis kyang dga' dad dang 'jigs skrag ngam ngam shugs kyis 'chor gyin rang gis bsgrigs pa'i bod skad dang bod rig slob deb sogs dang lam rim chung ngu'i lhag mthong dang / rnal 'byor dag pa'i rim pa'i nyi hong 'gyur sogs sgrub pa'i mchod par phul skabs lam rim chung ngu de deb grangs ji tsam par skrun byas min bka' sngon brjod/brtsams deb rnams skabs der sgrub pa'i mchod sprin gyi tshul du phul ba tsam las gzhi rtsa'i cha nas gus rang gis 'bul lam zhu dgos par brten rjes sor yig zam thog 'bul lam zhu 'thus stan seng zhus par bka' las da re lhan du bsnam phebs rgyu yin zhes bka' bstsal/ de nas byin rlabs zhus te re zhig phyir log byas/ da dung de rjes ches/ 10 nyin 'oka khyo la mgon po gang gis bka' slob bka' drin bskyangs skabs mi mang sar khyod rang gis rnal 'byor dag pa'i rim pa bsgyur par brten de'i rgyab rten du rje'i rnam gzhag rim pa'i rnam bshad 'gyur dgos zhes bka' drin 'khor mtha' med pa'i bka' lung rjen par bstsal lan du bka' bzhin bsgrub chog pa'i bka' lan phul/ gzhan yang ha las datre sa shig la de rjes chibs zhabs gsung 'gyur sku zhabs lhag rdor lags mjal bar bcar skabs 'phros mol zhor du khong gis gsungs gsal khyed rang gis phul pa'i dpe deb tshang ma khyer shog ces bka' phebs skor gsungs tshe/ a la la 7skyabs mgon chen po ni thun mong snang tshod la yang bya ba chung chung 'di lta bu la'ang zhal nas gsungs pa nang bzhin phyag len spi 'gel pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gangs ri dang 'dra ba zhes pa de rang red snyam pa'i nges pa lhag par rnyed/gang ltar 7skyabs mgon rje btsun bla ma'i gsang gsum gsang ba pha mtha' mi mngon pa'i byin mthu la brten nas bdag la rgyal pa shākya thub pa dngos su mjal yang 'di lhag dga' dad skye rgyu e yod pa'i snyam pa'i tshor snang ston mi nus pa skyes shing / gong zhus rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'dzoms pa la brten nas rlung nad de yang de nas bzung tsher ma bton pa ltar rang yal du phyin/ de rjes bdun phrag gcig tsam rjes nas bzung bdun gcig gi ring skabs don gzhung dang 'brel ba yod pa'i rgyud dang rgyud 'grel rnams zhib tu mjal nas sdur zhib thog nas rang sbyong byas te gtsug lag slob dpon chen po grong byang dang mnyam du bdun rer gza' pa sang nam shar la snga dro chu tshod dgu pa nas dgong ༷'i chu tshod dang po bar bsgyur nas rtsogs par bsgyur thub pa de yang skyabs mgon chen po'i 'phrin las nyid du nges/gnyis pa skyabs rje khri byang rin po che dang mjal tshul/ phyi wo/ 196'a bod zla/ 11ches/ 7 skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yongs 'dzin 'khor lo sdom pa mi'i gar gyi rnam par rol ba mtshan brjod sngon brjod/khri byung rdo rje 'chang (1901—1981)gi zhal snga nas kyi sku dkyil rdor gdan du mjal te lus kyi ba spu gzings por g.yos pa'i dga' dad skyes/ rdo rje 'chang gis bdag la sdom pa gong ma gnyis gnang nas gsang sngags bstan pa la bcug pas ceraba'i bla ma bka' drin che shos shig yin/ de yang sa skya legs bshad (2 275)las/ sna yi tshab dang nyos pa'i bu/ /g.yar po'i rgyan dang brkus pa'i nor/ /slob dpon med pa'i rig pa rnams/ /yod kyang gzhan gyis brtsi ba med/ / ces gsal ba bzhin slob dpon gong ma'i bshad srol dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gtsug gi rgyan du bskur nas dbu sems kyi gzhung lugs chen mo la sbyangs rjes gzhi nas dbang dus su las blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams snying thag pa nas srung mnyam pa'i sgo nas gsang sngags la 'jug dgos pa yin/ bdag gsang sngags bstan pa la 'khrug rkyen yang / ji skad du rgyal ba sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes rgyal ma'apron rnam thar (206/119607676167mas0(57170baḥbyamatsho(khub/108 11636kha50ba'isdu cas 2057sku'isa'i khri 5'i khyila'i 75 marnguba'i/ 1997 9 12731/ 3—14)las/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i lugs 'di la/ bla ma dang / yi dam/ chos skyong sogs kyang gang byung gis mi yong / bla ma yang sangs rgyas nas bzung dam pa bar ma chad pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa/ dam tshig la sel ma zhugs pa/ rang ṣ+kanyams myong gi steng nas slob ma 'khrid nus pa sogs kyi yon tan mang po dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ yodam yang bde gsang 'jigs gsum ya ma bral ba/chos skyong yang chos skyong du ming btags pa tsam gyis mi yong / rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' sdod thun mong ma yin pa mgon chos rnam gsum gyis chog zhes pa nas/ las rgyu 'bras kyi spang blang gco bor ston pa skyes bu chung ngu'i lam gyi chos skyong ni dge sdig shan 'byed dam can chos rdzirgyal po yin/ lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum gco bor ston pa skyes bu 'bring gi lam gyi chos skyong ni rgyal chen rnam sras yin/ byung chub kyi sems sgom pa'i man ngag gtso bor ston pa skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi chos skyong ni ye shes mimagon po phyag drug pa yin pas de gsum gyis mi chog pa'i chos skyong gang yang med/ ces mkhas grub chen po yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi tas ji ltar gdams pa bzhin thugs mad par gda'/ de yang chos rje dpal ldan pas kho bo la shar pa'i lung pa shod rong du/ phyi lo/ nya961 lor nyin gcig gong gi yongs 'dzin rnam thar zhib tu klog 4565/—

sngon brjod/dgos bka' lung stsal pa ltar ljags klongag zhus skabs gsang bde 'jigs gsum ya ma bral ba nyams su len dgos zhes bka' slob gnang ba bzhin de ltar ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang mjal ba'i smon lam brgyab/ de nas gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag zhwa ser bstan pa'i bdag po skyabs rje khri byung rdo rje 'chang rje btsun blo bzang ye shes dgung lo re gsum du phebs pa gang gi zhal snga nas kyis phyi lo/ 1963 bod zla/ 8 tshes/ nya8 nyin rgya gar ḍa la hor ser rgyud grwa stod smad mkhan bla dge 'dun yongs cogs dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po slob gnyer ba sogs dge 'dun bdun brgya skor la rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po gsang 'dus 'phags lugs lha so gnyis pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rje tsong la pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor dag rim (106 kho0 5303 /'i)dang / dkyil chog dbang don rab gsal (10smo sa0 5287 bu'i)gyi dgongs don gzhi bzhag thog dbang gi sta gon nyin gcig dang / dngos gzhi nyin gnyis dgyes bzhin stsal song ba'i skabs/ bdag kyang bla ma rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos 'dud pa'i skal bzang dga' ston mngon du gyur te dbang gral du tshud cing / skabs der bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis smin byed dbang tsam min par rgyab rten kyi rgyud kyi khungs dang bcas grol byed lam rim gnyis kyi 'khrid bcas dbang bshad ha cang zab la rgya che ba dang / phyag len phra mo tshun chad zhib tshags bka' stsal bar brten bka' dbang ting gung chu chod dang po nas dbu btsugs kyang chu tshod bdun pa tsam thugs 'gor gnang gi 'dug kyang skabs der rang nyid lo na ga'on pa'i stabs kyis rig pa gsal ba dang gcig rkyen ngan sna tshogs sne bsdoms kyi dbang gis chos ma gtogs gzhan dran rgyu med pa dang gnyis/ dbang chubs pa nas ma grol bar spyod lam tshul mthun sgo nas yengs med du nyan ba dang gsum/ lam rim dang gzhung lugs kyi go ba cu zad yod pa dang bzhi bcas kyi gzhi rtsa la brten nas dbang gi dmigs rim rnams dbang brda phrod cing thad ka thad gar dmigs pa skyong khul byas/ skabs der dbang zhu mkhan gyi slob gnyer ba'i nang nas nga rang lo na gzhon shos dang thabs skyo shos yin kyang bla ma rdo rje 'chang ni thugs gshis ha cang 'jam la dman pa la lhag par thugs brtse bar brten dgyes 'dzum dang bcas mi bskyod rdo rje zhes ming gsol ras gnang byung bas da lta bsam tshe gsang 'dus 'phags lugs la565//—

sngon brjod/gzhung la 'chad 'gyur cung zad byas dang byed bzhin 'di la dgongs par mngon/ gang ltar da lta yang bka' drin gzhal mtha' med pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi sku'i rnam 'gyur dang gsung gi nyams 'don stangs thams cad yid la lam mer dran gyin 'dug pas/ bla mas thugs la btags pa'i thugs rjes yin par mngon/ phyi lo/ 1968 pod zla/ 'tshes/ nyin gnyis kyi ring dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong min pa'i 'don sgrigs skyabs rje pha bong kha pa'i gsung gi steng nas bshad 'khrid thob/ skabs der shes rab sgrub skor sogs kyis mchoni dben sa stan brgyud man ngag zab rgyas su bka' bstsal/1969 bod zla/ 4 ches/ 'ang 'bu ma rgyud kyi gtso bo bde mchog gi rgyud don 'grel mkhan lha nag dril gsum gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa grub chen kun tu dga' ba'i lugs sam lū i pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu re gnyis pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bde chen gsal ba (070 5323 17)dang /mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bde chen rol mtsho (10khyi sa0 5478 068)gzhi bzhag steng nas dbang chen sta gon dang bcas pa stsal song ba'i chos gal tshud cing / skabs der bla ma rdo rje 'chang bgres tshul bzhes pa'i dbang gis khri thog tu bzhengs nas lung bstan gnang mi thub par bzhugs nas gnang yang / gsung ni stan zhing dag cing yid du 'ong ba thos pa tsam gyis yid tshim pas lus sems la dga' bde'i dpal ster ba/ rgyun chags shing 'brel la tshig zur phyin pa/ zlos pa'i skyon med pa/ nye ba rnams la ta cang mi che zhing / ring bar gnas pa rnams la mi chung ba/ ljags bshad zab la rgya che ba dang 'tsharma pa sogs kyi sku1na tan nyams pa med par gnas/ gzhan yang rda sar lo ngo gsum tsam sdod ring rdo rje 'chang thugs stod pa'i skabs rang gi rdogs gnas khrag la bka' dri nam zhus la 'di dang 'di nas gsal zhes thogs pa med pa'i bka' lan stsal/ nyi hong nas zhu yig nam phul la'ang sku ngal la ma 'dzems par bka' lan gnang ba'ang rdo rje 'chang gang gi 'al snga nas kyis (chab shog dris lan phyogs brtsebs/ 382272363)rgyal bstan phyogs brgyar spel ba la zla med pa'i khyu mchog chen po ā tsar+ya tshul khrims skal bzang mchog gi sku drung du/ 'bul 'bras/ deng sku 'cho'i ljon bzang brtan cing / legs mdzad kyi 'bras bzang mchog tu dar bzhin 'tsho gzhes yod pa sgro565///—

myon brjod/nas gsung bris gnang 'arbe1ra nang gsal rgya rngodad bka' bstan khag la gsan bzhes mu 'byums thog mngon pa mdzod kyi slob khrid spel gnang mdzad bzhin yod pa ni rjes su yi rang gi sgo nas legs so'i bsngags brjod zhu rgyu dang / lam rim bde lam nyi hong skad du phab bsgyur grub pa 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan srol yun gnas kyi dge mtshan med du byung bar thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu zhes pa nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag mi nyams dar spel gyi lhag bsam bzod stobs kyi khur chen sngar lhag tu 'degs bzhes yong pa dang / phun nas kyang sku mdzad legs lam du son phyir mchog gsum smon gsol zhus chog pa mkhyen/ mkhyen zhes yongs 'dzin khri byang sprul ming pas/ 1980 zla 9 tshes 'tsho la phul/ /zhes dang / mtha' ma'i zhal ta'ang skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang (1901—1981)gi zhal snga nas kyis/('phrin yig tshigs bcad stsal ba'i rim pa khag phyogs gcig tu bkod pa/ /9789381762—1832) yang dag thub tshul zla bed dge bcu'i khrims/ /phyogs mthar gsal ba'i bgo skal bde byung nor/ /legs smon bzang po'i rol mtshor smin pa'i 'bras/ /dri bral ston gyi lang tsho rgyas de'i drung / /lus kyi ljon pa 'phags yul 'dir brtan mod/ /mdza' ba'i me tog phyogs der dgod pa las/ /stan 'jebs bsung zhim 'phro ba'i ga bur 'di'ang / / khyod yid gdung sel dga' bskyed sman du re/ / rab dga'i mtsho chen spel ba'i 'phrin gyi zla/ / gzugs 'dzin ra ris sel ba'i bdud rtsi'i skyes/ / 'dzin mkhas shar gyi thig le gnyis pa des/ / bdag yid kun da'i 'dzum phreng cir yang dgod/ / sngon rabs nor gyi gnyen des rgya bal gnas/ /'grim pa'i gtam zhig grags pa'i lam du mchis/ /deng dus shar gyi gling du mngon pa'i gzhung / /'chad la slob dpon mchog cig mngon du gyur/ /e ma thub bstan nor 'dzin snyigs ma'i mtshor/ /dengs par nye yang snying stobs rus sbal gyis/ /'degs bzod dpung pa'i mthu nus 'di mthong bas/ /stobs kyi 'jug pa'i rabs kyang bden du dogs/ / bsil ldan chos kyi ma dros rol ba'i mtshor/ /legs smin gser sbyang dag pa'i mchod sdong che/ /sa mtha'i mun sel sgron per brjid pa de/ / thub ba stan ring du gnas pa'i cho gar gal/ /slad kyi char yang yang dag rig pa'i 'phrul/ / thub pa'i chos tshul tshul bzhin spyod pa'i sgo/ / rgya cher 'byed phyir phyir zhing mi zhum par/ / khams kyi 'phrod zab zab mo'ang mi g.yel 'tshal/—721stu

sngon brjod//zhes sogs bdag skya babs kyang dgyes brtse chen pos bong ba gser gzigs kyis gdeng 'jog dang thugs smon mdzad/ nya980 zla ba/ 3 ches/ 15 ma su rir skyabs rje rin po che mjal bar bcar/ skabs der rdo rje 'chang sku na shin tu bgres pa'i dbang gis bzhugs gdan steng zhabs gnyis brkyangs nas bzhugs kyang byus rig thor ba sogs bgres pa'i skyon dang bral te sku na dar babs pa lta bu'i thugs rig shin tu gsal ba'i sgo nas/ ngas khyed rang la stan ngag gi rtsom zhig btang yod par lan stan ngag gi rtsom zhig btang yong bsam byung mod btang ma byung rjes su khyod rang gi rtsom zhig 'gor dgod chog pa yod/ da bar bstan par phan pa'i las ka byas 'dug rjes su mu 'thud byed dgos ngas kyang smon lab brgyab chog zhes dang / khyed rang gis brtsams pa'i rgyal rabs bklags pas yag po byung shag ces bka' stsal byung yang / skya babs pas ha cang ngo tsha ba dang / rjes su rim pas mjal rgyu'i re bas zhal0ta dmigs bsal zhu rgyu ma byung / 1981 zla ba/ 11 tshes/ 18 nyin bal yul nas skyabs rje rdorje 'chang zhing la gshegs pa'i gnas tshul ngan pa'i 'phrin yig dang rgya gar nas myang 'das thang ka dang rje yab sras gsum gyi sku brnyan yod pa'i dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i thang ka bcas dus gcig tu 'byor/ re zhig mya ngan gyis brgyal pa sangs rjes/ rtags mtshan 'di dag bsams pas bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon zla med de nyid re zhig sku dngos kyi gdul bya jogs te dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du 'jam mgon tsong kha pa yab sras sku gam du gshegs pa'i snang ba shar/ lar nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid dus mthar rje rin po che'i bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin spel mdzad par bsam bzhin byon par brten tshobla ma gzhan dang bsdur na bgres pa'i mthar thug tu bzhugs 'dug pa'ang/yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes rgyal ma'ardon rnam thar (ba'i61115776761me mas0(57170baḥbyamasadzib/178 7/60sgyu'i 50ba'i3100 2057khri'ikho'i khri 5'i770ma sku5 kho097 1997 ba 282 smo 12—14) las/ te| ze'isko rin chen bzang po dgung yo dgu bcu go drug bzhugs 'dug cing / bla ma gzhan phal cher dgung wo sum cu nas lnga bcu'i bar gshegs pa shas che bar byung / zhes gsal bas kyang mtshon/ 198'a zla ba/ 7 ches/ 10 nyin skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs rtsogs ched rda sa khri byang bla brang du bcar te 7skyabs rje rin po che'i na zar phyag btsal nas byin rje'i

smyon brjod/rlabs zhus kyang gsung ma byon stabs ngu bzhin dga' ldan gyi zhing nas bdag cag bu slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i mgon 'don mdzad du gsokhag zhes gsol ba mang du btab/ de nas phyag mdzod sku ngo dpal ldan lags la thugs gso dang 'brel sku gdung zhal 'debs mtshon tsam phul/ zla ba/ 8 ces/ nya skyabs rje rin po che'i sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu dga' ldan tshogs chen du gdan zhu byas te thugs sras bla rti rin po ches dbus dga' ldan dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed dang 'brel thugs dgongs yongs su rjogs pa'i mchod 'bul zhus/ 'di ni skyabs rje rin po che'i sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu dga' ldan tshogs chen du gdan zhu byas pa'i thog ma yin stabs dge 'dun phal che ba thugs skyo nas spyan chab bsil ba mjal skabs bdag nyid kyang mchi ma mang du shor/ 1984 lor byams chos bskyar zhib drang nges mdzes rgyan skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang gi bka' drin rjes dran ched par skrun byas/gsum pa skyabs rje gling rin po che (1902—19834)dang mjal tshul/ phyi lo/ 196'bod zla/ nyanya nang wa ra ṇa sir skyabs rje yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gling rin po che'i zhal mjal/ 1966 phyi zla/ 10 tshes/ 'aX 'anya bar dga' ldan khri thog go bdun pa 'jigs byed mi'i rnam par rol gang gi zhal snga nas kyis ḍa la ho ser rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs za ma tog (10smo sa05336 11'i)dang / dkyil chog rin chen phreng ba (106 sa0 5339 11'i)gzhi bzhag steng nas 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i ras bris dkyil 'khor du dbang chen dang de rjes nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs dang / rgyud stod phyag 'debs pa po rgyud chen kun dka' don grub (1419—1486)kyi gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel bklag lung / thugs thog nas lam gatsho'i steng nas lam rim nyams 'khrid bcas stsal ba'i chos gral du tshud/ phyi lo/ 1963 bod zla/ 'a nang rgyal ba skal bzang gi dga' lha'i 'khrid yig dngos grub kun 'byung steng nas bshad khrid thob/ nya974 bod zla dang po'i nang drag po gsum sgril rjes gnang dang / 'phags bstod/ sgrol ma ma ṇi bcas kyi ljags lung thob/ phyi zla/ 5 tshes/ 4 bzung nyin drug gi ring rje rin po che'i dngos slob hor ston nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i blo spyong nyi ma'i 'or zer gyi bshad lung zhib rgyas thob/ 198'azla ba/ 7 tshes/ nyanya nyin nyi hong nas 'byor mjal la bcar te chos mngon mdzod dang —21—

sngon brjod/'brel ba'i spyi bshad 'grel pa mngon pa'i rgyan gyi rgyan sgrub pa'i mchod par dmigs te par phud du phul par dgyes tshor dang bcas gang spyir bka' mchid lhug por phebs pa/ 7skyabasarje yongs 'dzin khri byung rin po che sku dngos kyi 'dul bya thogs te bu pha khyim du log pa bzhin dgyes bzhin zho bzhin dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang du mi pham 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs dru phrebs/da cha dge lugs spyi yongs blo sting gtod sa rje bla ma nyid ma gtogs med pas bstan 'gro'i mgon du sku tshe zhabs pad brtan dgos pa'i gsol pa btab par/ bka' las skyabs rje khri byung rin po che dgongs pa thogs pa 'di las sdug pa yong rgyu yod pa ma red ces gsungs/ de bzhin rang nyid slob gnyer byed skabs rgan rgya mtsho sbyin pas dbus gdan sa gsum gyi rgan rnam pas rtsod zla'i tshul gyis blo skyed tshad ped gnang ba'i bka' drin gyi cha shas gsab phyir 'jang dgun chos bskyar gso thub thabs 'brel yod mkhan po rnam par re skul zhu 'dod yod pas de don 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug gnang rogs zhus par ngas smon lam rgyab chog gsungs shing /da lta 'jang dgun chos kyi 'chad rtsod dar rgyas du bzhugs pa 'di yang rje bla ma 'di'i thugs smon bka' drin yin pa shod ci dargos/ thugs zhin tu thim pas de sngon bcar skabs phyag dbang tsam bkra' mchid lhug por byon pa byung myong med kyang da re zhal ta zhib rgyas su phebs pa ni sku tshe 'dir rmejal ba'i skal ba med pa la dgongs par mngon/ kha 'don chad stabs ji ltar legs min zhal ta zhus par 'jigs byed bdag skyed bton na chog 'thus dang / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs bskyar du ma zhus na bdag skyed 'don mi chog pa'i bka' phebs/ 1995zla ba/ 'a tshes/ 10 rda sar skyabs rje gling rin po che'i dmar gdung mjal te dbon gnyer rgyud stod pa zhig pa 'dug pa khong la sku gdung zhal 'debs mtshon tsam zhig phul/ zla ba/ 3 tshes 14 'bras spungs tshogs chen du dgye 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed dang 'brel mo thugs dgongs yongs su rjogs pa'i mchod 'bul zhus/5 'chad 'gyur snam/ dang po slob 'khrid/ bod du don khang 'brug rgyas sogs la dbu med bslabs pa ni nga'i mi tshe 'dir gzhan la stob 'khrid byas pa dang po yin/ rda sa dpe mdzod khang du phyi rgyal 'ga' shas la bod kyi skad yig dang lcang skya grub mtha' bslabs pa gnyis pa yin/ gtso bo ni las —211—

sngon brjod/mchorna khri'i par dang bcas gsham gsal/ bod rig pa slob mkhan/ skyed tha ni gtsug lag slob grwa chen mo'i gtsug lag slob dpon chen po khung dkar tshul khrims skal bzang /dgungalo/ 55 khyo tho la dus rabs phyed kyi phyed bzhugs shing bod kyi nang rig dang rig gzhung nyams zhib pa tshul khrims skal bzang mi shes mkhan nyi hong mi med par mngon/ gtsug lag slob grwa chen po'i gtso 'dzin dang / gtsug lag slob grwa chen po'i gtsug lag slob dpon chen mo mi nyung ba zhig khang dkar tshul khrims skal bzang sku mdun nas bod skad dang bod kyi skor sbyangs nas mnyam 'brel thog nas nyams zhib gnang yod/ khong nas khyo tho la yong nas yag po byung gang lags zer na shes rig rnying pa dang / nang pa'i gtsug lag slob grwa chen po yod pa red ces gsungs/ gtsugaḥslob grwa chen mor snga dro snga po phebs te dgong dro phyi po bar slob spyong gnang bzhin bzhugs mazloni ridangos gnas drang nas slob gnyer kho na gnang mkhan zhig red/ bod kyi nang rig sku tshab mtshon mkhan lta grub mkhan po rje tsong khra pa'i dbu ma'i gzhung chen nyi hong skad du bsgyur pa dang / bod rig pa nus shugs dang ldan pa'i thog nas nyi hong du gdan drangs/ chos rgyal skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma nying hong du chibs bsgyur skabs sku jo mas skru mdun du bcar dgos pa'i bka' bstsal te khong gi 'gyur gyi las 'gul la bstod bsngags mdzad yod/ rje btsun shin ran gyi mi mthun blo pham gces btus bod skad du bsgyur bas mtshon yul gnyis kyi nang chos brje len la 'bad brtson gnang yod/ de min blo mthun rnams bsdus te mi lo nyi shu'i ring bdun rer thengs gnyis rer gla med du bod rig pa slob 'khrid gnang yod par ma zad/ skabs skabs slob yul slob khang gla cha yang khong rang sger nas zhal 'debs phul yod/ ces gsal/ yang sting nyi hong nub phyogs su bod kyi chos rig dar rgyas chen po byung ba 'dir bdag gis shugs rkyen chen po yod/ kho bo slob 'khrid zhus pa'i nang gtsug lag slob grwa chen mo'i gtsug lag slob dpon chen mo mi nyung ba zhig thon yod pa ni sub tu med pa'i bdag gi byas rjes yin/gnyis pa brtsams chos/ rang nyid mkhas 'dod grags 'dod ched du min par bod kyi chos rig la phugs su sman pa'i kun slong bzang po'i sgo nas sus kyang ma bskul par ngal ba khyad bsad kyis brtsams pa'i ngag rtsom par du 'khod pa khrag ni gsham gsal/—21ga

sngon brjod/nya nyi hong chos 'byung phyogs bsdus/ nyi hong / nya977'a bod kyi lo rgyus phyogs bsdus bod dang bod mi/ rgya gar/ 19803 bod kyi mtshan nyid kyi gzhung la slob gnyer byed tshul skad gnyis shan sbyar/1901(74 sher snying tshig don la cung dpyad pa'i gtam/ rgya gar/ 19805 deng rabs bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i bod skad skad gnyis shan sbyar/nyi hong /19806 byams zhus le'u 'phros don dang bcas pa'i dpyad zhib/ rgya gar/ 19817 cho mngon pa dang 'brel ba'i spyi bshad 'grel pa mngon pa'i rgyan gyi rgyan/rgya gar/ 198'a8 byams chos bskyar zhib drang nges mdzes rgyan/ rgya gar/ 1984rdzo bstan pa snga dar gyi chos 'byung 'brel yod dang bcas pa'i dus rabs kyi mtha' dpyod 'phrul gyi me long / rgya gar/ 198510 tshad ma'i lo rgyus dar ṭīka mdzes rgyan/ nyi hong / 1986nyanya lag len bod skad sum rtags skad gnyis shan sbyar/ nyi tong /nya987nya' mi mthun blo pham gces btus/ rje btsun shin ngan gyi zhal gdams/ yul gangs can gyi sgra 'gyur lo cis ba khang dkar tshul khrims skal bzang gis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/ nyi hong / 198813 tshur mthong skye bor snang tshul ma bcos lhug par bkod pa'i rgya gar gyi nang pa'i lta grub chos 'byung legs bshad dka' gnad mdud 'grol/ (deb sngon gsar ma ) nyi hong / 198814 chos mngon pa'i lta grub 'phel rim 'brel yod dang bcas pa'i dpyad zhib mchims mdzod mdzes rgyan/ (deb ther ser po ) nyi hong / 199'a15 bod kyi ma chos zab mo dang yon tan gzhi gyur ma'i snga 'grel/ nyi hong /la ga

smyon brjod/199'a16 rgya gar gyi nang pa'i gsang sngags kyi lta grub kyi chos 'byung /(deb ther ljang gu )nyi hong / 199'a17 de min rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i zhib lkog tshogs pa'i dus deb tu 'khod pa'i dpyad thung kyis mtshon bod yig thog bris pa'i rtsom mi nyung ba zhig yod pa thams cad 'dir ma bkod/gsum pa 'gyur/1 rje tshong kha pa'i kun gzhi dka' 'grel skad gnyis shan sbyar/nyi hong / 199nya' rje tsong khra pa'i rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma skad gnyis shan sbyar/nyi hong / 199nya3 lam rim chen mo zhi gnas skabs skad gnyis shan sbyar/nyi hong / 199nya4 lam rim bsdus don skad gnyis shan sbyar/nyi hong / 199nya5 lam gtso rnam gsum skad gnyis shan sbyar/nyi hong / 199nyachu lam rim bde lam/ nyi rtong / 19937 smon lam zhing mchog sgo 'byed/nyi hong / 19938 rgyal sras lag len/ nyi hong / 1993tsho theg pa gcig dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sting po'i lta grub skor/ nyi hong /199310 sa skya legs bshad skad gnyis shan sbyar/nyi hong / 1994nyanya chos rje ngag dbang dpal ldan gyi rgyud sde bzhi'i sngags kyi sa lam skad gnyis shan —271—

skyon brjod/sbyar/ nyi hong / 1994nya' rje tsong kha pa'i rnal 'byor dag pa'i rim pa skad gnyis shan sbyar/ nyi hong /199513 rje tsong kha pa'i lha mthong chung ngu skad gnyis shan sbyar/ nyi hong /nya99rica14 drang nges legs bshad sting po skad gnyis shan sbyar/ nyi hong /nya99815 bod kyi rig par 'jug sgo/ nyi hong / 1996de min sngags rim chen mo'i sa chog skabs kyi 'gyur dang nyi hong skad thog bris pa'i dpyad thung cung zad mang tsam yod kyang yig tshogs mang bas ma bris/ slar smras pa/ dang po rgya chen thos pa mang tsam btsal/ / bar du gzhung lugs gdams par ma shar kyang / / tha mar thos don nyams su len par 'dun/ / bstan pa rgyas phyir 'chad 'gyur rtsom par brtson/ /tshul 'di bsam bzhin 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ / bka' drin che'o mtshan ldan bla ma tsho//'chad 'gyur rtsom pa'i sngon byas bgyis pa la/ / dga' bas ca co 'di yang shar mar shal/ /zhes mjug sdom chigs su bcad pa'o/ / 7 bsngo smon/ sa yi yang thog jo mo glang ma dang / / sa 'brel zur mtsho 'khris mkhar zhes grags pa/ /sa ma 'brog gis khul skyid po yi/ /sa bdag gral rim rigs su skyes pa bdag nya/sa mkhan lo chen dran dbang rim byon gyis/ /sa le sbram dang sku srog blos btang ste/ /sa dbus 'phags pa'i yug nas gdan drangs pa'i/ / sa sdes mchon pas dbu sems gzhung lugs la/ 'a/sa rngog bu gsum brgyud 'dzin slob dpon mdun/ / sa bcad tsam min gzhung gi lus kun la/ /sa chod chen pos zhib tu sbyangs pa'i mthar sa bzang nyi rtsa'i yul du zhib tu spel/3 /sa gter dang mtshungs dbu sems dka' ba'i gnad/ / sa steng bsto dang mi gnyis zhib dpyod rtsom/ /sa 'dzin dkar po 'di dag bgyis pa'i dges/ /sa zhigo la'i khor yug gling chen du/ 4/sa g.yo rdul mtshon la sogs gnod 'tsho rnams/ /sa phyogs gang du'ang mi /khung mi grags bzhin/ /sa lugs dge lugs dar pas skye —2sto//—

ni sems tsam pa'i lta grub mang po zhig yod pa'i nang nas kyang gal che shos yin par brten 'jam mgon cong khra pa chen pos drang nges su de'i nang don la dmigs phug pa'i dpyad zhib mdzad pa las lhag pa zhig bshad rgyu med/ 'on kyang de dag nang don du byed pa'i gzhung gi byung rim dang lta grub 'phel rim dag gangs ljongs su grags mi che bas cung zad 'chad kyi yin/'a sa'i dngos gzhi'i0ngo bo nyid gsum/sa'i dngos gzhi ( 770 4035 1561 16235—6 bas0 5536 251 18586—7 11579 ji 3450rdzas/ ngo bo nyid rnam pa gsum ste/ yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / gzhan gyi dbang dang / kun tu btags /sde dge par mar kun brtags zhes gsal kyang kun btags zhes 'thad pas bcos pa yin//pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / ngo bo nyid med pa rnam pa gsum ste/ mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa (145la'i la6572665576)dang / skye /(2283465 223467—83 19 3620)yongs su grub pa'i mas nyidayod pa nyid dang / gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid yod pa nyid dang / kun bshas pa'i ma' nyid yod pa nyid dang / zhes ngobo nyid rnam pa gsum dang ngo bo nyid med pa rnam pa gsum gyi ming tsam gsal/ wo sa dang byang sar tha snyad de dag mi gsal bas na sa'i dngos gzhi'i nang nas kyang de gnyis dang por brtsams rjes sa'i dngos gzhi'i gzhung lhag ma rnams rjes rol du brtsams par mtshon/ gong zhus wo sa dang byang sar ngo bo nyid gsum skor mi gsal yang byang sa'i de kho na nyid kyi le'u yi skabs dgongs pa 'grel pa'i gtan la dbab pa bsdu pa (24038921 1861 bas0 5539 sgri 1966 1 1579 9 7032)las/ de kho na'i don rnam par shes par 'dod pas/ ngo bo nyid gsum la brtson par byu ba'i sdom ni/ /rten dang rnam par dbye ba dang / /rten dang rab dbye brten pa dang / / phra la mngon par zhen pa dang / / ming brjod ji bzhin mngon par zhen/ /rngo bo nyid gsum gang zhe na/ kun btags pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid dang / yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid do/ / kun btags pa'i ngo bo nyid gang zhe na/ ji tsam du rjes su tha snyad gdags pa'i phyir ming dang brda las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid gang yin pa'o/ /gzhan gyi dbang gis ngo bo nyid gang zhe na/rten cing 'brel bar yang ba'i ngo po nyid gang yin pa'o/ /yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir dang / mtshan ma dang / gams ngan len gyi 'ching ba thams cad las rnam par thar par bya ba'i phyir dang / yon tan thams cad mngon par bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul 'phags pa'i yeshes kyi dmigs pa gang yin pa'o/ /zhes gsal lo/byang sa ( 250 4037 lta1 2567—267 ri 226 lta0 99 45 / 25—46 1 7 226 05 ji 31 // 5—10 1 1579 9 4886)las/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams midangos po mchatshon nyid gsum/med de/ de gnyi ga yang mi rigs so/ /'di lta ste dper na/ gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po rnams yod na/ gang zag gdags su rung gi/ med du zin na ni dngos po med pa la gang zag gdags su med do/ /de bzhin du gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams kyi dngos po tsam yod na/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos 'dogs pa'i tshig nye bar gdags su rung gi/ med du zin na dngos po med pa la gdags pa'i tshig gis nye bar 'dogs pa med do//zhes dang / byang sa ( 22665—2723 226 shag0 99 47 1 16—48 1 6 825 05 ji 323 11 11—21 199 4883—4897)las/ gang gi phyir gang la gang med pa de ni des stong par yang dag par mthong la/ 'di la lhag ma gang yin pa de ni 'di ni yang dag par yod do zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes pa de ni stong pa nyid la yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du phyin ci ma 'edzig par zhugs pa zhes bya ste/ 'di lta ste gzugs zhes bya ba la sogs pa ji skad bstan pa'i dngos po rnams la gzugs zhes bya ba la sogs par 'dogs pa'i tshig gi bdag nyid kyi chos med de de lta bas na gzugs zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i dngos po de gzugs zhes bya ba la sogs par 'dogs pa'i tshig gi bdag nyid des stong ngo // gzugs zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i dngos po de'i lhag ma gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya ba la sogs par 'dogs pa'i tshig tsam po 'di yin te/ de gnyi ga yang 'di lta snyeste/ dngos po tsam yod pa dang / dngos po tsam du 'dogs par yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin spi rab tu shes te/ sku da pa ma yin pa la yang sgro mi 'dogs la/ yang dag pa la yang skur pa mi 'debs so/ / lhag par yang mi byed la nyung ngur yang mi byed do/ /'dor bar yang mi byed la/ ston par yang mi byed de/ yang dag pa ji lta ba de bzhin nyid brjod du med pa'i rngo bo nyid du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes pa de ni stong pa nyid legs par zin pa zhes bya ste/ yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis shin tu rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsal ba bzhin gzugs dang / 'dogs pa'i tshig gi bdag nyid dang / stong nyid bcas chos skad gsum gsal la de dag ngo bo nyid gsum gyi lta grub kyi rtsa ba yin/gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba (2 21 3231—59 271 3464—83 17080)las/ ji ltar gzugs la tre(gas pa ming can gyi dasnga sa dze la/ gzugs la tre1gas par 'a༄dugs pa btags —3

mtshan nyid gsum /pa las yod pa yin gyi/ rdzas las ma yin par khong du chud par byu zhe na/ mngon par brjod pa la yongs su goms pa'i ming la gnas pa'i rnam par shes pa'i dmigs pa gzugs la sogs pa'i ming can gyi dngos po gzugs la sogs pa'i bdag nyid gang gis yod pa de ni bdag nyid des rdzas dang don dam pa gnyi gar yang med rdo/ / de lta bas na gzugs la sogs pa'i ming can gyi chos de dag gi ngo bo nyid yod pa ma yin pa las des kun btags pa gang yin pa de ni btags pa las yod pa yin par rig par bya'o/ / mngon par brjod pa la skyesangs su goms pa rnam par bstsal ba'i ming can gyi rnam par shes pa'i dmigs pa gzugs la sogs pa'i ming can gyi dngos po brjod du med pa'i bdag nyid gang gis yod pa de ni rdzas dang don dam pa gnyi gar yang de bzhin du yod par rig par bya 'o/ /de la de rab tu grub par bya ba'i rigs pa brjod pa ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sar bstan pa de bzhin du rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang /byung sa (227 74—7 9 826 shig0 ji 48 /1 10—229 226 05 bab 32 / 23—33 1 99 19 4898)las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang srid pa 'pho ba'i mdo/don 'di nyid tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad du/ ming ni gang dang gang gi su/ / chos rnams gang dang gang brjod pa/ /de la de ni yod ma yin/ / 'di ni chos rnams chos nyid do/ / zhes gsungs te tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don ji ltar bstan ce na/ gzugs la sogs par ming btags pa'i chos kyi gzugs zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i ming gang yin pa gzugs zhes byu ba la 11gas pa'i ming des gzugs la sogs par ming btags pa'i chos de dag la gzugs zhes bya ba'am/ tshor ba zhes bya ba nas rgyas par mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ba'i bar spi brjod cing bstad pa de la gzugs zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i chos rnams bdag nyid kyang gzugs kyi bdag nyid ma yin la/ de dag la yang de las gzhan pa gzugs la sogs pa'i bdag nyid chos med de/ gzugs la sogs par ming btags pa'i chos de dag gis brjod du med pa'i don du yod pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ yang dag par ngo bo nyid kyi chos nyid yin par rig par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs/ /rtags 'di'i nang yod pa rnams snge dge par ma'i phyi mo bzhin yin/ / rje tshong kha ba'i lha sa par ma'i drang nges legs bshad —4

mtshan nyid gsum/sting po (2sa0 5396 2631531—187)las/ sgro skur du lta ba'i tshul dang / de gnyis 'gog pa'i tshul lo/ dang po ni/ byang sa (10khyi 2531—2 226 70 9 449 226 khu'i 9 30 11 5—71las/ ji ltar yod ce na /rang gis mtshan nyid kyis /yod pa ma yin pa la sgro btags pa'i legs par ma zin pa spangs pa dang yang dag pa la skur pa btab pa'i legs par ma zin pa spangs pa yod do/ zhes sgro skur spangs pa'i tshul gyis yod do zhes gsungs pa'i sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs ni ji lta bu zhig yin zhe na/ de gnyis ni byang sa /106 2563—4 286 gag0 9 46 9 226 05 9 30 11 26—28/las/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams dang / la/gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos po la 'dogs pa'i tshig gi rngo bo nyid kyi rang gi mtshan nyid yod pa ma yin pa la sgro btags nas mngon par zhen pa gang yin pa dang / zhes pa 'dis stoda'adogs tshul gsungs la/ (22564—5 886 gag0 9 46 226 05 99 30 1 28—31 / 2)btags pa'i /'dogs pa'i /tshig gomatshan ma'i gzhi btags pa'i /'dogs pa'i /tshig gi mtshan ma'i rten du gyur pa/ brjod du med pa'i bdag nyid kyis don dam par yod pa yang dag pa'i dngos po la thams cad kyi thams cad du med do zhes skur ba 'debs shing chud gzon par byed pa gang yin pa 'di gnyis ni chos 'dul ba 'di las rab tu nyams pa yin par rig par bya'o/ zhes pa snga mas ni skur pa 'debs tshul bstan la chud gzon zhes pa man chad kyis ni theg pa chen po'i chos zab mo las nyams par bstan no/ /gzugs zhes pa nas dngos po la zhes pa'i bar gyis kun btags 'dogs pa'i gzhi bstan te/ de la 'dogs pa'i tshig gi ngo bo nyid ces pa ni tshig gis btags pa'i ngo bo nyid la bya'i/ 'dogs byed kyi chigo la mi bya ste bsdu ba la sogs pa nas gsal bar (6)bshad do/ / byung sa'i skabs gzhan du byung ba rnams kyang de ltar shes par bya'o/ /tshig gis btags pa'i ngo bo de nyid rang gomatshan nyid kyis yod pa min pa la de'i rang gi mtshan nyid yod do zhes zhen pa ni sgro 'dogs so/ / btags pa'i tshig gi mtshan ma'i gzhi ni btags pa'i tshig gi mtshan ma'i rten zhes pas bshad de kun btags kyi gdags gzhin/ /de nyid brjod du med pa'i tshul kyi don dam par yod pa la thams cad kyi thams cad du med do zhes 'dzin pa ni skur 'debs so/ /de ltar byas na kun btags don dam —5

mtshan nyid gsum/par yod do/ /zhes pa ni sgo 'dogs dang ngo bo nyid gzhan gnyis don dam par med do zhes pa ni skur 'debs yin te/sgo dang po kun rjob dang gzhan gnyis don dam par yod pa'i phyir ro/ /don dam par yod pa la med par lta ba skur 'debs su bshad pa'i zlas drangs na don dam par med pa la yod par lta ba sgro 'dogs su bshad dgos la skabs 'dir kun btags rang gi mtshan nyid kyis yod par 'dzin pa la sgro 'dogs su gsungs kyis de don dam par yod par 'dzin pa tshig gis gsal bar ma bstan kyang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis yod na don dam par yod pa gzhung gi don yin pas kun btags don dam par sku da pa sgro 'dogs su 'gro ba'i phyogs so/ / dgongs 'grel las/ kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid kyi gnas 'du byed kyi mtshan ma ngo bo dang khyad par du 'dogs pa'i gzhi gzhan dbang la gsungs pas/ gzhung 'dis btags pa'i chigo gi mtshan ma'i gzhi don dam par skudzid pa la med ces gsungs pa'i dngos bstan (168)gzhan dbang yin mod kyang / de don dam par med na yongs grub kyang don dam du med par 'gyur bas gnyis ka la bshad pa la skyon med de byung sa las/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams kyi dngos po tsam la skur pa 'debs pa la ni de kho na yang med la 'dogs pa yang bed de de gnyis ka yang mi rigs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir te dngos po gzhan dbang la skur pa 'debs tshul ni tha snyad du med do zhes pa'am spyir med do zhes pa min gyi sngar gong du don dam par yod pa la med ces pa skur 'debs su gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa /de gnyis 'gog pa'i tshul/ni/ gal te sgro skur byed tshul de ltar yin na de gnyis spong tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ de la sgro 'dogs kyi mtha' ni chos gang la yang de'i ngo bo dang khyud par du btags pa des de don dam par stong par bstan pas 'gog ste zhib tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ / skur 'debs ni byang sa /22621—2 226 70 ji 46 226 05 9 31 1 22/las/ de ma thag tu drangs pa'i lung de dang de'i rjes thogs su 'di lta ste dper na/ gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po rnams yod na gang zag gdags su rung gi med du zin na ni dngos po med pa la gang zag gdags su med do/ /de bzhin du gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams kyi dngos po tsam yod na gzugs la sogs pa'i chos 'dogs pa'i tshig nye bar gdags su rung gi/ /med du zin na dngos po med pa la —6

mtshan nyid gsum/gdags pa'i tshig gis nye bar 'dogs pa bed do/ / de la 'dogs pa'i gzhi med du zin na ni gzhi med par 'gyur bas 'dogs pa yang med par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas bkag (61)go /de la 'dir skur 'debs 'gog pa'i phyogs snga khas len mkhan ni gzhan sder 'ong don ped la rang sde yang nyan thos sde pa la ming dang brdas tha stad 'dogs pa'i gzhi'i gzugs sogs kyi dngos po rang mtshan nyid kyis med ces khas len pa yang med do/ /des na bsdu ba las bshad pa ltar theg pa chen po'i grub mtha' smra ba yin la de yang chos rnams rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub ces smra ba'i ngo bo nyid med par smra ba rnams so/ de dag gis ni gzhan dbang la sogs pa'i chos rnams spyir mi srid pa dang tha snyad du med ces 'dod pa gtan min pas don dam par ma grub ces smra'o/ / des na dngos po tsam med na zhes 'gog pa ni sngar bshad pa ltar don dam par yod pa'i yang dag gi dngos po mi srid ces 'gog pa yin te/ 'di'i lugs kyis kun btags la rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub pa dang don dam par med na med mi dgos kyang / ngo bo nyid gzhan gnyis don dam par ram rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub na med pa yin no/ / gzhan dbang sems sems byung rang gi rgyu rkyen la brten nas skye ba de rang gi rang mtshan gyis grub pa'i skye ba yin na don dam pa'i skye bar 'gyur la/ de min na blos skye bar rloms nas skye'o zhes btags pa tsam du zad kyi sems sems byung gi dngos po la skye ba yod bar mi 'gyur ro snyam du lugs 'dis bsams so /des na gzhan dbang gi skye 'gag blo 'khrul pas skye 'gag tu zhen pa tsam gyi ngor yin pas kun thob tu skye 'gag yod pas skur 'debs su mi 'gyur ro zhes (173)pas lan mi thebs te/thag pa la sbrul du zhen pa'i 'khrul ngor thag pa sprul yin la spyir thag pa sprul du grub ma myong zhes pa dang 'dra bar gzhan dbang gi rgyu 'bras kyang rgyu 'bras bden 'dzin gyi 'khrul ngor rgyu 'bras yin gyi/ gzhan dbang kho rang rgyu 'bras su ma grub ces 'dod na ni de 'dra khas blangs kyang dge sdig las bde sdug skye ba'i las 'bras gzhag sa med par song bas skur 'debs spong mi nus la/ de 'dra min pa'i rgyu 'bras 'dod ni rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i rgyu 'bras yin pas don dam par sku1da pa'i don grub pa yin no snyam du bsams nas/gdags gzhi med na 'dogs pa yang med pas chos thams cad btags pa tsam yin pa dang —7

mtshan nyid gsum/de nyid de khro na'i don du byed pa gnyis ka mi srid pas chad lta'i gtso bor 'gyur ro zhes bshad de/ byang sa ( 22622—6 286 gag0 9 46 226 05 ji 31 1 181las/ de bas na gang zag kha cig shes par dka' ba'i mdo sde theg pa chen po dang ldan pa zab mo stong pa nyid dang ldan pa dgongs pa'i don bstan pa dag thos nas bshad pa'i don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du ma shes nas /na/ tshul bzhin ma yin par rnam par brtags te rigs pa ma yin pas bskyed pa'i rtog pa tsarma gyis 'di thams cad ni btags pa tsam du zad de/ 'di ni de kho na yin no su 'di ltar lta ba de ni yang dag par lta ba yin no zhes de ltar lta zhing de skad smra'o/ /de dag gi ltar na 'dogs pa'i gzhi'i dngos po tsam yang bed pas 'dogs pa de nyid kyang thams cad kyi thams cad du med par 'gyur na gdags pa /btags /tsam gyi de kho na lta yod par ga la 'gyur te/ de (6)bas na rnam grangs des na de dag gis ni de kho na dang btags pa de gnyis ka la yang skur pa btab par 'gyur te/ btags pa dang de kho na la skur ba btab pas na med par lta ba'i gtso bo yin par rig par bya'o zhes gsungs shing / de la dgongs nas gang zag tu lta ba ni bla'i stong nyid la log par zin pa de ni de lta min no zhes gsungs te/ snga ma ni shes bya la rmongs pa tsam yin gyi shes bya thams cad la skur pa mi 'debs shing gzhi des dmyal bar mi skye la/ gzhan chos 'dod pa yang phung bar mi byed bslab pa'i gzhi la yang g.yel bar mi 'gyur la/ phyi ma ni de dag las bzlog par 'gyur bas so zhes byang sa /22627—61 226 yig0 ji 47 226 05 bab 31 22—32 / 1/las gsungs so/ / de ltar byas na gang la gang med pa de ni des stong zhing lhag ma gang yin pa de ni yod pa yin la de ltar mthong ba ni stong nyid la phyin ci ma log par zhugs pa yin te/ gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos po rnams de dag tu tshig gis btags pa'i ngo porme stong pa ni tshig snga ma'i don yin la/ lhag ma yod pa ni gdags gzhi'i dngos po tsam dang 'dogs pa tsam yod par byung sa las gsungs te/ gang gis stong pa ni kun btags dang gang stong pa'i gzhi gzhan dbang dang snga mas phyi ma stong pa'i stong pa yongs grub yin la de dag gi yod med kyi don ni sngar bshad pa ltar ro/ /de ltar sgro 'dogs kyi mtha' spangs pas ni yod pa'i mtha' dang skur 'debs spangs pas med pa'i mtha' spangs pas gnyis su —8

mtshan nyid gsum/med par rab tu phye ba yang yin zhing / 'di 'dra ba'i stong nyid ni don dam pa'i mthar thug tu bshad de/ byang sa (188)las dngos po snga ma gang yin pa dang dngos po med pa 'di gnyis kyi yod pa dang ped pa las rnam par grol ba'i chos kyi mtshan nyid kyis bsdus pa'i dngos po de ni gnyis su ped pa yin no/ /gnyis su med pa gang yin pa de ni dbu ma'i mtha' gnyis spangs pa bla na bed pa zhes bya ste zhes so/ /zhes sogs nang don rje thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa ltar yin mod kyang do snang byed dgos pa zhig ni byang sar ngo bo nyid gsum gyi tha snyad med kyang de'i gzhi rtsa'i lta grub gsal bar gsal por chags so/ / yang 'dir do snang byed dgos pa zhig ni mdo sde dgongs 'grel gyi rgong rol du sa'i dngos gzhi brtsams nas bzhugs pa ni deng rabs mkhas pa tsam min par slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis kyang zhal bzhes gnang 'dug pa yang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i dang po'i rnam par dbye ba bshad pa (2sa0 3995 bug 2267—2321)las/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa dang dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa las kyang chigo so sos brjod do/ / zhes pas kyang mchoni/3 dgongs 'grel gyi ngo bo nyid gsum/mdo sde dgongs 'grel gyi yon tan 'byung gnas le'u (2sa0 106 bu'i 145—65 2sa0 774 saḥ5 183—19 byasabya 99 60—61 16763 99 693'i kyi bab 6693—6702)las/ yon tan 'byung gnas chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni gsum po 'di dag yin sta/ gsum gang zhe na/ kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid dang / gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid dang / yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid do/ yon tan 'byung gnas de la chos rnams kyi kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ ji tsam du rjes su tha snyad gdags pa'i phyir chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid dam bye brag tu ming dang brdar rnam par gzhag pa gang yin pa'o/ /yon tan 'byung gnas chos rnams kyi gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ chos rnams kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba nyid de/ 'di lta ste 'di yod pas 'di 'byung la/'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye pa 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba nas/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'di 'ba' zhig po 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gang yin pa'o/ /yon tan 'byung gnas chos rnams kyi yongs su grub pa'i —9

mtshan nyid gsum/mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rtun pa'i rgyu dang / legs par tshul bzhin yid la byas pa'i rgyus de rtogs shing de rtogs pa goms par byas pa yang dag par grub pas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par chogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar du yang dag par 'grub pa gang yin pa'o/ /yon tan 'byung gnas 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu gang zag rab rib can gyi mig la rab rib kyi skyon chags pa de lta bur ni kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid du blta bar bya'o/ / yon tan 'byung gnas 'di lta ste dper na/ de nyid la rab rib kyi mtshan ma skra shad 'dzings pa'am/ sbrang ma'am/ til gyi 'bru'am/ khyodan po'i mtshan ma'am/ ser po'i mtshan ma'am/ dmar pe'i mtshan ma'am/ dkar po'i mtshan ma snang ba gyur pa de lta bur ni gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid spi blta bar bya'o/ /yon tan 'byung gnas 'di lta ste dper na/ skye bu gang zag de nyid kyi mig yongs su dag cing mig la rab rib kyi skyon chags pa dang bral bar gyur pa na/ mig de nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi spyod yul ma nor ba'i spyod yul de lta bur ni yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid du blta par bya'o/ /zhes gsal ba ltar ngo bo nyid gsum gyi go don gtan la dbab ba bsdu ba dang / 'phags pa khro na'o/ /ma 'gags pa kho na'o/ /gzod ma nas zhi ba kho na'o/ / rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa kho na'o zhes chos kyi don la sgra ji bzhin kho nar mngon par zhen par byed do/ /de cad la mtshan nyid thams cad kyis skur pa 'debs te/ chos rnams kyi kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid la yang skur pa 'debs chos rnams kyi gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid dang yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid la yang skur pa 'debs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ don dam yang dag 'phags/ 'di ltar gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid dang yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid yod na ni kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid kyang rab tu shes par 'gyur na/ de la gang dag gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid dang yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid la mtshan nyid med par mthong ba de dag gis ni kun btags pa'i mtshan nyid la yang skur pa btab pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de lta bas na de dag ni mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum char la yang skur pa 'debs pa zhes bya'o/ / zhes so/ /don la sgra ji bzhin du zhen zhes pa'i sgra ni ngo bo nyid med par ston pa'i mdo sde las chos thams cad don dam par rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang ngo bo nyid dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong zhes gsungs pa rnams yin la de dag la ji ltar bstan pa ltar 'dzin pa ni sgra ji bzhin par 'dod pa'i lugs so/ / gzhan dbang dang yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid la mtshan nyid med par mthong ba ni de gnyis rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub par lta ba ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ zhes pa man chad kyis ngo bo nyid gsum ga la skur 'debs su 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan ston no/ / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis skye ba dang 'gag pa med par gsungs pa ltar bzung na yang gzhan dbang la skur 'debs su 'gyur ba'i phyir gzhan gnyis la yang skar 'debs su 'grob shes par bya ste/ skye 'gag rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub na skye 'gashe med par 'gyur ba'i lugs dze / /zhes dze gas rgyas par gsal/gong gsal drang nges su gzhan dbang sgyu ma dang 'dra tshul ni 'chad par 'gyur zhes —/9

ma'atshon nyid gsum/gsungs pa bzhin drang nges (2562—2625)las/ gal te dgongs 'grel las gzhan dbang sgyu ma bzhin du gsungs shing / rgyan las kyang 'dus byas thams cad sgyu ma bzhin du gsungs pas bden dang srog la sogs par med bzhin du der snang ba'i cha nas sgyu ma dang / phyi'i skye mched drug gang zag ge bdag gi nye bar spyad byar bed bzhin du der snang ba'i cha nas rmi lam lta bur mdo sde las gsungs par bshad kyi phyi nang gi 'dus byas rang bzhin gyis stong bzhin du der snang ba'i dper ma gsungs so/ /theg bsdus / 070 4048 sa 1937—63 'di ltar gzhan dag 'di snyam du don med pa ji ltar spyod
