rten 'brel/pa'o/ / rab tu rnam par phye bas sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' 'gags pas lam gyi rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ / de ltar lam 'di gsum ni bdag med cing bdag dang bdag gi dang bral bar 'byung zhing 'jig pa ste/ rang bzhin gyis mdung khyim lta bu'o/ / zhes gsal/ ye shes la 'jug par (1 1544)rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dus gsum du yod pa'i rnam gzhag tsam las ma gsal yang / de'i rjes rol phyi lo/ 150 tsam la brtsams pa'i bye brag bshad pa chen mor (1 1545 9 1226)rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis nyon mongs dang las dang sdug bsngal bcas chos gsum du bsdu tshul rten 'brel sting po dang 'dra bar gsal bar ma zad glu sgrub kyis mdzad par grags pa'i sher phyin man ngag (1 1509 9 10(6)tu'ang gsal/ bye brag bshad pa chen mo brtsams nas mi ring bar klu sgrub byon yod pas skabs der rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis chos gsum du bsdu tshul yongs grags yin par mchon/ rje tsong kha pa'i gser phreng (250 5412 1568 18563—4)las/ dbu ma rten 'brel sting po las/ dang rngo1 brgyad pa dgu shesan 31ngas/ / zhes pa nas/ kun btus (21 6636)las/ rnam shes las kyi kun nyon spi gsungs pa'i rgyu dus kyi rnam shes kyis las kyi bag chags bzung ba tsam la dgongs so/ / zhes gsal ba ltar rten 'brel sting po rang lugs su bzhed par ma zad se ra rje btsun pa'i rten 'brel spyi don (2366—2434)las/ yan lag bcu gnyis po de nyon mongs gsum du 'du ba yin te/ ma rig pa/ sred pa/ len pa'i rten 'brel gsum nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs par 'du/ 'du byed dang / srid pa'i rten 'brel gnyis/ las kyi kun nas nyon mongs par 'du/ lhag ma bdun skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ che'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ sdug bsngal gyi kun nas nyon mongs pa'i 'du ba'i phyir te/ dbu ma rten 'brel snying po las/ rdeng po brgyad pa dgu nyon mongs/ / gnyis pa bcu pa las yin te/ /lhag ma bdun ni sdug bsngal yin/ / zhes dang / mdzon (111 tha 26/las/ nyon mongs gsum mo las gnyis so/ / gzhi bdun de bzhin 'bras bu yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/kun btus /2 6685—61las/ ma rig pa gang yin pa dang / sred pa gang yin pa dang /dren pa gang yin pa 'di ni nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs par bsdu'o/ / 'du byed gang yin pa dang / rnam par shes par gang yin pa dang / srid pa gang yin pa 'di ni las kyi kun —363

rten 'brel/nas nyon0mongs par bsdu'o/ / lhag ma rnams ni tshe yin kun nas nyon mongs par bsdu'o/ /zhes rnam shes kyi rten 'brel las kyi kun nas nyon mongs par bshad pa'o rgyu dus kyi rnam shes kyi rten 'brel de 'phen byed las kyi bag chags bsgo ba'i gzhi yin pas de las kyi sgras btags pa yin gyi/ de las ma yin te/ de gtso sems yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsal/ /'a rten 'brel sting po'i rang 'grel (( 250 3837 193 14861—4)las/ 'chi la'i sems la brten nas skyes pa'i char gtogs pa'i sems kyang de bzhin te/ de dag nyid dang de las gzhan zhes brjod par mi nus so/ /zhes pa nas/ phung po ni/ gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po'o/ /de dag nying mtshams spyor ba zhes bya ba ni 'gags nas rgyun de las 'byung ba gzhan dag 'byung ba ste/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du dngos po rdul phra mo tsam yang mi 'gro'o/ /zhes gsal/ de'i bshad bya rtsa ba'i mdo sa bcu pa ( 222335—6 5006636 9 202khoras/de de ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la rnam pa bcur rab tu rtog cing bdag med pa dang / srog med pa dang / gang zag med pa dang / ngo bo nyid kyis stong ba dang / rang bzhin gyis byed pa po dang / tshor ba po med par rab tu rtog pa'i tshe/ stong pa nyid kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo skyes yin/ zhes dang / phyogs mtshungs sā lu'i ljang pa'i mdo (120 ribangabs0 210 1563 122 —7)las/ de la chos gang yang 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du mi 'pho mod kyi/ lgu dang rgen ma tshang ba med pa'i phyir las kyi 'bras bu mngon pa yang yod do/ /'di lta ste/ darber na khrob tu phyis pa'i be yong gi dkyil 'khor la bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba yang bzhin me long gi dkyil 'khor du ma 'phos mod kyi/ rgyu dang rkyen ma tshang med pa'i phyir bzhin du mngon pa yang yod do/ /de bzhin du 'di nas kyang su yang shi 'phos pa med la gzhan du yang ma skyes te/ rgyu dang rkyen rnams ma tshang ba med pa'i phyir las kyi 'bras bur mngon pa yang yod do/ zhes pa nas/ de bzhin du bdag po med pa'i chos/bdag gi med pa/ 'acingan pa med pa/ nam mkha' dang ma〈(ngas pa/ sgyu ma'i mcharan nyid kyi rang bzhin dag la rgyu dang rkyen rnams ma tshang ba med pa'i phyir skye ba'i gnas nying mtshams spyor ba ma'i mngal de dang der sa bon rnam par shes pa las dang nyon mongs pa rnams kyis bskyed pa —364—

rten 'brel/ming dang gzugs kyi myu gu mngon par 'grub ste/ de ltar na nang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rkyen dang 'brel bar lta'o/ / zhes gsal ba rnams khog gcig sa lu'i ljang pa'i mdo (1708)ni phyi khro/ 'a'a' 'a'atsho bar la rgya nag tu bsgyur yod pas mgon po klu sgrub kyi rgong rol du brtsams nas bzhugs par the chomi med/bzhi pa dbu ma pa'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis/dbu ma'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis ni rtsa be rab byed nyer drug pa srid pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis brtag par gsal/ rab byed der gsal ba'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis ni nyan thos sde pa'i sde smod du gsal ba de rang las dmigs bsal khyad chos med/ der brten dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa bud+dha pā li ta (0kho0 3842 15827633)las/ da khyod kyis nyan thos kyi gzhung lugs kyi don dam pa la 'jug pa ston cig 'dir bshad pa/ ma rig bsgribs pas yang srid phyir/ / zhes sogs rtsa she'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis rnam gzhag ni nyan thos kyi sde stod du gsal ba'i don dam bden pa'i rnam gzhag yin pa gas la/don dngos yod cha nas rtsa she'i rab byed nyer lnga pa myang 'das brtag pa'i mtha' ma tshigs bcad nyer ba'i pa las/ dmigs pa thams cad nyer zhi zhing / / spros pa nyer 'i zhi ba ste/ /sangs rgyas kyis gang du yang / / su la'ang chesas 'ga' ma bstan stong/ / zhes mjug ༷dzim rnam par gsal ba ltar rtsa she'i gzhung gi lus dngos gzhi de nas rtsogs pa yin/ rtsom gshis cung zad mi 'dra ba'i rab byed nyer drug pa srid pa'i yan lag brtag pa dang / rab byed nyer bdun pa lta ba brtag ni khra stong mjug rtsom lta bu yin par cha bzhag na 'grig cig shos slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyi zhes rab skyon ma (gu saX 3853 15622497)las/ stong pa nyid kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi khyad par dgag pas tha snyad pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bstan pa'i don gyi dbang gis rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa drug pa brtsam mo/ / zhes/ slob dpon 'dis kyang tha snyad pa'i rten 'brel rnam gzhag tsam yin par gsungs/ da ni 'dir dpyad dargos pa zhig ni slob dpon 'dis ma rig pa yang rgyu rkyen la brten nas byung bar 'dod pas de ci yin zhes na de ni phyi ci log gi kun rtog yin par 'dod de rtsa she (2 1365 55///tsā 5 /)las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ / kun tu sna ga las 'byung bar gsungs/ / zhes dang / (2—365

rten 'brel/1462 551// smo 22)las/ de ltar phyin ci log 'gags pas/ / ma rig pa ni 'gag par 'gyur/ / ma rig 'gag par gyur na ni/ /'du byed la sogs 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes rab byed nyer gsum pa phyin ci log brtag pa las gsungs pa ltar yin/ de yang lta sa par ma'i rtsa she ṭīka chen (2822265—22373)las/ mdo sde las/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug rnams tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa las 'byung par gsungs zhes pa nas rten 'brel gyi mdo las/ ma rig pa'i rgyu gang 'e na/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa'o zhes dang yid la byed pa rnyog pa can las gti mug skye ba yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir gti mug kun rtog las skye bar shes so/ /'es gsungs/ gzhan yang sa lha lnga pa'i mdo dang / sa bcu pa dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bar srid rnam gzhag gsungs ped kyang /slob dpon legs ldan gyi shes rab sgron ma (2156225087—61)las/ bar do'i srid pa med par yang la don dang mar me+e dang / rgya dang / me long dang / skad dang / pe shel dang / sa bon dang / skyur dag gis phung po'i nying mtshams spyor ba mi 'pho bar mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya'o zhes zer/ zhes pa'i phal chen sde pa'i 'dod pa ni gong gi rten 'brel snying po'i chigs bcad lnga pa dang tshigs bcad yin min khyad par tsam las brjod don mthun/ spyan ras gzigs brtal zhugs kyi shes/ rab smon pe'i 'grel bshad (250 3859 2330963—31027)las/ rdoge 'dun phal chen sde rme sogs pa'i slob dpon rnams kyi bar ro'i srid pa med par sgrub pa'i rjes su dpag pa gzhan yin 'es pa nas slob dpon legs ldan 'byed nyid ni bar do'i srid pa yod par 'dod rdo/ / zhes sogs gsal ba ltar gong gi lta grub de phal chen sde pa'i lta grub yin par gsal/lnga pa dbu ma pa'i stong pa rten 'byung don du 'char tshul/rtsa she rab byed nyer bzhi pa 'phags pa'i bden pa brtag pa (55/ga stu 18 gu1586)las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba (97311(5 mchi mas5(9763)gang / de ni stong pa nyid (867536)du bshad/ /de ni brten nas gdags pa (5ba 7657391 83629(1 )ste/ /de nyid dbu ma'i lam (bo'ispu'i5 mal 791811 ba'i )yin no/ / zhes pa 'di dbu ma'i rten 'brel skabs su gal che shos yin pas cung zad zhib tsam 'chad 'dod yod/ chigo gsal (5 sku—366—

rten 'brel/16735)bod 'gyur tredzeng dang 'dra ba gang zhig la/ ga las 'jigs med (2 50 3829 1538927)dang / sangs rgyas bskyangs ( 15227186)dang / shes rab sgon ma (1568 23061)las/ rten cing 'brel byung gang yin pa/ / zhes 'gyur cung mi 'dra/li tshig gsal du bzhugs pa'i legs sbyar phyi smad tsam las rtsa she'i legs sbyar phyi mo ma bzhugs par brten 'gyur mi mthun pa'i skor la deng rabs kyi mkhas pa tshos kyang rang blos gang dpog tu bzung ste dpyad pa byed kyi yod par ma zad 'jam mgon tsong kha pas rtsa r+sha ṭīg chen (2822082—5)du'ang gal cher dpyad zhib mdzad sku da/ gong gi tshigs bcad kyi thad kyi tshig gsal (2 16765—6 259 9 504 / 14)las/ de'i phyir de ltar na stong pa nyid dang / brten nas gdags pa dang / dbu ma'i lam zhes bya ba 'di dag ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba nyid kyi ming gi bye brag yin no/ zhes dang / rtsa she ṭīka chen (2225036—25134)las/ gal te rang bzhin gyi grub pas stong pa'i don rten 'byung gi don yin no zhes mang du gsungs na 'di'i don gang yin/ ji ltar lto sdir ba bum pa'i don du 'jog pa lta bu'i don yin na ni/ 'bras bu rnams rgyu rkyen la brten nas 'byung bar nges pa'i blo de nyid kyis stong pa'i don yang nges par 'gyur bas mi rigs so/ /'on te rten 'brel rjod byed kyi ma'i don nyid stong pa'i don du 'dod na'ang gnod pa de nyid yod do/ / ci ste rten 'brel rdongos su nges pa'i shugs kyi don la 'dod na'ang sngar ltar mi 'thad pas 'di'i don gang yin snyam na de ltar mi 'dod do/ /'o na ji ltar 'jog snyam na/ stong pa'i don rten 'byung gi don du 'gro ba ni rang bzhin gyis grub pa tshad mas khegs pa'i dbu ma pa rnams la yin gyi gzhan la min ces/ / de 'du ba'i dbu ma pa la sna phyi nang gi dngos po rnams rgyu la rag las pa'i rten 'byung du dngos su nges pa na/ blo de nyid kyi mthu la brten nas rang bzhin gyi yod pas stong pa'i don du nges par 'gyur ro/ / rang bzhin gyis grub pa gzhan la ltos pa med par rtogs shing de dang stan 'byung gnyis 'gal bar tshad mas rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rten 'byung nyid kyis rang bzhin gyis yod pa khegs pa'i stong nyid la nges pa rnyed pas ni/ nam myu gu la sogs pa rgyu rkyen la ltos par mthong ba dang thos pa dang dran pa'i mod la rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis rang bzhin med pa yin pa'i tshul sems pa la goms par byu'o/ / de ltar byas na tshe rabs gzhan du rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa dngos su ma bshad —367

rten 'brel/kyang rten 'byung gi chos bshad pa nyid kyis stong pa nyid kyi lta ba'i bag chags sad par 'gyur te/ rta thul gyis kun tu rgyu nye rgyal la bden pa bzhi'i rten 'brel tsam zhig bshad pas de kho na nyid rtogs pa bzhin no/ / rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa de ni brten nas gdags par bzhag ste/ 'khor khro la sogs pa shing rta'i yan lag la brten nas shing rtar 'dogs la/ rang gi yan lag la brten nas btags pa ni rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i stong pa'o/ / rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i stong pa nyid de ni yod med kyi mtha' gnyis spangs pas dbu ma dang de'i lam ste dbu ma pas bgrod pa'i shul yin no/ / de bzhin du rtsod zlog /7 711las kyang / gang gis stong dang rten 'byung dang / / dbu ma'i lam du don gcig par/ / gsungs mchog mtshungs pa med pa yi/ / sangs rgyas de la phyag kha༅byel mdze/ / zhes de gsum rnam grangs par gsungs so/ / 'es dang / de'i snga na yang mkhas dbang bstan dar lha rams pa'i lam gco rnam gsum 'grel par (1682061—2134)gsal/ lam rim chen mor (mtshon sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khung gis par du bskrun/ /985 bab 585—587)yang zhib tu bkral pa ltar rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang rten 'brel sogs bzhi don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su 'dod dgos/ deng rabs mkhas pa mang po zhig gis rtsa she'i tshig zin gyis 'khrul rkyen byas te/ stong nyid dang rten 'brel sogs bzhi ming gi rnam grangs su 'dod pa ni mi 'thad/ gal srid de bzhi ming gi rnam grangs yin na bum pa rten 'brel yin pas stong nyid yin par 'dod dgos la de ltar 'dod na stong nyid dang sgab pa'i chos kyi gzhi mthun yod par 'dod dgos/ la de ltar 'dod na za sgrub kyi grub mtha' ldang 'gal ba'i skyon yod/ zhib cha rtsa she'i rab byed dang po'i tshigs dzocad dang po'i skabs kyi shes rab rje na pe dang :rdog gsal du gsal/gzhan yang chi'i/ gsal (27462—3 252 9 214 / 13)las/ gang dag bdag dang dngos po rnams de dang bcas pa nyid du smra ba de dag ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mchog tu zab pa rtag pa dang chad pa dang bral ba brten nas gdags pa'i ming can gyi de kho na nyid mthong ba ma yin no/ / zhes rten 'brel dang brtem gdags pa don gcig par gsungs/ de bzhin drang nges legs bshad nying po (10khri sa0 5396 263 10365 10471toras/ phung po la brten nas btags pa nyid kyis bdun po der gang zag mi rnyed pa —368

rten 'brel/gang zag gi bdag med kyi don yin pas rten 'byung gi rigs pa la thug go /de ltar na brten nas skye ba dang brten nas btags pa'i gtan tshigs kyis rang las skye ba la sogs pa bzhi dang rang bzhin gcig dang tha dad la sogs pa bdun chos dang gang zag la 'argog pa 'di nyid rigs pa rnams kyi don por zungs shig ces dang / lam rim 'bring po (10khri sakya 5393 263 17284)las/ rten 'byung bi gtan tshigs kyi rnam gzhag gnyis so/ / brten nas skyes pa dang brten nas btags pa yin/ zhes gsal/drug pa tha snyad rnam 'jog gi stan 'brel/ de yang pā lu'i ljang pa'i mdo (2 50 210 rtsi ri'i 11636—7)las/ dge slong dag sus rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mthong ba des chos mthong ngo / / sus chos mthong ba des sangs nas mthong ngo zhes gsungs pa de la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang zhe na/ rten cing 'asbrel bar 'byung ba zhes byu ba ni 'di lta ste/ 'a di yod pas 'di 'byung la/ 'di skyes pa'i phyir 'di skye ba ste/ zhes dang / de'i don mchims mdzod (146007)las/ mdo las/ 'di yod na 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pas 'di skye'o zhes rnam grangs gnyis gsungs pa ni ma rig pa la sogs pa 'di yod na 'du byed la sogs pa 'di 'byung gi med na ni mi 'byung la / de bzhin du 'di skyes na 'di skye'i 'di ma skyes na ni 'di mi skye'o zhes nges par gzungaba'i don dang / ma rig pa 'di yod na 'du byed 'di 'byung la/'du bye 'di skyes pas rnam par shes pa 'di skye 'o/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa yan lag brgyud par bstan pa'i phyir ram/ sngon gyi mtha' 'di yod na da ltar gyi mtha' 'di 'byung la/ da ltar gyi mtha' 'di skyes pas phyi ma'i mtha' 'di skye'o zhes tshe brgyud pa gnyis bstan pa'i phyir ram/ /de dag gnyis ka ltar na yang dngos dang brgyud pa'i rgyu dang 'a bras bur bstan pa'i phyir te/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed ces byu ba la sogs pa ni rgyas par bshad pa yin no/ /zhes dang / cig shos dpal ldan zla grags kyis mdo de'i don lugs mchog dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i bzhed srol thun mong ma yin pa phan tshun ltos grub kyi don du bkral yod/ de yang dbu ma 'jig pa'i rang 'grel (bas0 3862 5329063—29184)las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la chos kyi brda (spu'imatsho d+ku ri mtshosmokhu tha' 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste/ 'di yod na 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pas 'di skye ste/ gang 'di ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du rnams —369

rten 'brel/le'u bzhi pa mjug 'doms/ mthar lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i rte 'brel gyi bshad srol 'di bzhin rten 'brel gyi chod 'doms lta bu gal che bas cung zad brjod de mjug bsdu ba ni/ lcang skya grub mtha' (grub mtha' thub bstan lhun po'i mdzes rgyan/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/ krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun lang bis par du bskrun/ 1989 bab 309 1 8—310 / 25)las/ mthe)ra bsdus na dngos po rnams kyi yod pa'am grub pa'am 'byung ba rgyu dang rkyen la ltos pa ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don no zhes bya ba ste/ tshig gsal (265)las/ / de'i phyir dngos po rnams kyi 'byung ba rgyu dang rkyen la ltos pa ni rten cing 'brel bar 'a byung ba'i don to/ / zhes gsungs so/ de ltar shing rta chen po rnams kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i (91'i 1 〉mchims5(2562)sgra'i ༄dun 'chad lugs mi 'dra ba mang du skyedad pa rnams legs par shes pa gal che ste/ 'di la brten nas rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs kyi don la khyab che chung dang de bo na nyid kyi gting dpogs pa la nges pa skyed lugs mi 'dra ba'i gnad du ma 'ig yod pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang rgyas par gzhan du 'chad 'dod pas dpal ldan zla ba'i bzhed pa mdo tsam brjod par bya ste/ de ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don 'phrad pa dang ltos pa dang brten pa la bshad du yod par grub pa'i rgya mtshan ni 'di ltar yin te/ spyir 'phrad ltos rten gsum rnam grangs par yang gsungs re da rkyeng bo'ib chags sla ba'i phyir phul nas brjodar+sha na/'phrad pa zhes bya bas ni gtan tshigs kyi don dngos po rang gi rgyus bskyed pa'i rten 'brel 'dzin pa yin la/ 'di ni grub pa'i mtha' 'og ma dang yang thun mongs pa'o/ / de yang de tsam zhig rten 'brel gyi don du 'dod par 'dra bas thun mongs pa zhes bya yi de dag gis 'dod pa'i rten 'brel bden pa pa 'dod pa ni ma yin la de dag gis bden med bsgrub byar 'dod pa yang ma yin no/ / 'phrad pa ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i skye 'gag gi bya ba 'phrad pa la byu yi rgyu 'bras gnyis 'phrad pa ni ma yin no/ / ltos pa 'es bya bas ni 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams rang rang gi cha shas la ltos nas rang gi bdag nyid rnyed pa'i gtan tshigs bstan pa ste sa mushrī da grub pa la 'chad pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ / 'di ni snga ma las/ khyab che 'ing dngos bstan gyi don tsarma dbu ma pa gzhan dang yang thun smadangs patshe / / brten pa zhes bya bas ni chos thams cad brten nas btags pa'i gtan tshigase/ kyi don bstan pa ste/ rang rang gi gdags gzhi la —379

rten 'brel/brten nas btags pa tsam du grub pa'o/ / 'di ni lugs mchog tu gyur pa 'di kho na'i khyud chos yin te/ rang rgyud pa man chad dang thun mongs ma yin pa'o/ /de ltar na chig gsal gyi lung de'i dngos po 'byung ba zhes pa'i 'byung ba'i don skye ba tsam la byas na gtan tshigs snga ma dang / grub pa dang yod pa la byas na gtan tshigs phyi ma gnyis kyis ston no/ / rgyu dang rkyen la zhes bya ba mdzes pa'i rnam dpyod can phal mo che zhig gis da dung ma thon 'dug go'aphrad ltos rten gsum rnam grangs par byas pa'i sgo nas kyang gtan tshigs phyi ma kho na 'chad tshul gzhan dag gis ma thon pa
